items.title: Leza Usimango (Cila)
verses:
Leza, Usimanga,
Tulakulumbisya,
Mbuwatupa ciindi ceci,
Ocakunjila mo.

Cikombelo ceci,
Casalilwa uwe,
Njilila kunjiyo, Mwami,
Ukale munjiyo.

Cazakilwa uwe,
Uciswezye, Mwami,
Obantu babungana mo,
Abo baswezyiwe.

choruses.text:
Ulemekwe, Mwami,
Uibuke Koonse,
Uzibwe kubantu boonse,
Abo benjila mo.

items.title: Amukombe Mwami
verses:
Amukombe Mwami wakujulu,
Amwiimbe luyando lwa-Leza;
Ntobo yesu a-Mugwasyi a-Conde
Mupati, ukankamanisya, nguwe.

Amwiimbe nyoonse luse lwakwe,
Utupa munzenge akumweka;
Uzuma mumakumbi amujulu,
Uleenda mumudima amuluwo.

Bana batete abateteete,
Twasyoma mulindinywe, O-Mwami
Mutubambe aluse lwenu buyo,
Mulengi a-Mugwasyi a-Muvuni.

items.title: Akulumbwe Akulumbwa
verses:
Akulumbwe akulumbwa,
‘Ansi ano akujulu,
Taata, Jesu, Muuy’Uusweya
Sunu mane kuta

items.title: Taata, Twabungana Sunu
verses:
Taata, twabungana sunu
Amug’anda yako,
Tulayanda ukupegwa
Icipego cako.

Alakambaukwa muno
Amakani aako,
Swebo atukateelele
Oonse majwi aako.

Alo ali kulya kwesu
Nkotukut’ ankulo,
Ali maanzi aakupona
Ngotuyoonywa ngao.

Kulalweela oku koonse
Ukwa-Mwami wesu,
Atupegwe swebo toonse
Oko kwakujulu.

Mwami, tulalumba eno
Ukwaabila kwako,
Nkonkuko nkotukumbila
Aluzyalo lwako

items.section: Leza Taatesu: Milimo Yakwe Aluzyalo Lwakwe
items.title: Leza Uusweyisya! Sinsana! Syoonse (Cila)
verses:
Leza Uusweyisya! Sinsana-syoonse,
Muunza amasiku oonse twakutembaula
Leza Uusweyisya! Icenana ndiwe,
Mutalabala, Keemb’ Uusweya swe.

Leza Uusweyisya! Basinkombe boonse,
Bafutusi, basolozi, bakuvundamina;
Mdiwe uutakanka, ndiwe uutamana,
Mwiinzo wabuumi butamani pe.

Leza Uusweyisya! Mwami uutabonwa,
Bubi mbubwatukasizya kwako kubu-lemu;
Icenana ndiwe, kwina uukukozya
Umulondosi, Moz’ uutuba bu.

Leza Uusweyisya! Sinsana-syoonse,
Ansi ano, ezeulu, syoonse sitembaule;
Leza Uusweyisya! Luse oinsana,
Ukulindiwe silizwile mwa.

items.section: Leza Taatesu: Milimo Yakwe Aluzyalo Lwakwe
items.title: Atwiimbile Leza (Cila)
verses:
Atwiimbile Leza,
Inguwe Usyeesu;
Atwiimbile Jesu,
Mufutuli wesu.

Moza Uusweyisya
Aimbilwe ndiswe;
Atulange syoonse
Sintu nsyaatupa.

Ansi, ezeulu,
Koonse, olyoonse;
Tulemeke Leza,
Mwani wasikwense.

items.section: Leza Taatesu: Milimo Yakwe Aluzyalo Lwakwe
items.title: Wakatuyanda Bobuya
verses:
Wakatuyanda bobuya,
Aluyando ulupati!
Kufutuke bantu bakwe,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

Kristo ulatuyandisya,
Utwaambila aluyando
Akwalo ukutufwida,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

Wakasama buntu bwesu,
Waba Munununi wesu,
Amana mapenzi eesu,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

Acisamu wabafwida
Bantu bakali kufwide,
Mucuumbwe wakazundila,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

Ulisumpwidwe kujulu,
Watumpukwa cincini,
Abasunu abaciindi,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

choruses.text:
Amumulemye Wisi,
Amumulemye Wisi,
Amulemye, amulemye,
Amulemye Mwami Leza.

items.section: Leza Taatesu: Milimo Yakwe Aluzyalo Lwakwe
items.title: Atwiimbe Cakusakwa (Cila)
verses:
Atwiimbe cakusakwa,
Omyozo isalala;
Luse lwakwe talumani,
Wasyomeka, Usimanga.

Atwiibusye luse lwakwe,
Luye mpuwo koonse koonse;
Luse lwakwe talumani,
Wasyomeka, Usimanga.

Syoonse situsekelezya
Sizwa Kwakwe, Leza wesu;
Luse lwakwe talumani,
Wasyomeka, Usimanga.

Wakatupa buumi bwesu,
Utulela cakufuna;
Luse lwakwe talumani
Wasyomeka, Usimanga.

Nkaako atutembaule
Leza wesu, Usinsana;
Luse lwakwe talumani,
Wasyomeka, Usimanga.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Kamuboola Ku-Betelehemu
verses:
Kamuboola bantu bayandika bakwe,
Kamuza inywe ku-Betelehemu;
Amumulangile Mwami wabaangelo,
Mubolle tumukombe, Kristo Mwami.

Mwiimbe baangelo alusyomo lwini,
Mwiimbe nyoonse nomukala kujulu;
Mwiimbe kuli-Leza uuli kujulu,
Muboole tumukombe, Kristo Mwami.

Mwami, tukukombe nowazyalwa sunu,
Jesu Mwami, atukutembaule;
Ncisyomezyo ca-Leza kulindiswe,
Muboole tumukombe, Kristo Mwami.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Masiku Aasweya
verses:
Masiku, aasweya,
Kuumuna, kumweka,
Nkufwaafwi banyina mwana,
Bakalikusweya loko,
Oona mukuumuna,
Oona mukuumuna.

Masiku, aasweya,
Beembezi babona,
Bulemu buzwa kujulu,
Abaangelo baimba,
Jesu wazyalwa,
Jesu wazyalwa.

Masiku, aasweya,
Muvuni umweka,
Busyu bwako bwatuba bu,
Kukuzyalwa kwalufutuko
Mwami Jesu wesu,
Mwami Jesu wesu.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Lufu Lwakwe
items.title: Kuli Cilundu Akule
verses:
Kuli cilundu akule,
Kumbali Kumuunzi,
Nkwakafwida Jesu ciindi,
Kajayilwa bantu.

Tatulwizi luu olu,
Mbuli mbwakafwide,
Pele tulizi kabotu,
Wakatujayilwa.

Wakafwa kuti tupone,
Tuvunwe milandu,
Netusanduka tubone,
Jehova mupati.

Takukwe umbi uponya,
Bantu ibabija,
Takwe umbi utubonya,
Inzila impya.

Watuyanda cinicini,
Aswe tumuyande,
Tubambe imbeta zyakwe,
Ati tuyoopona.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Pupulala Basinkombe (Cila)
verses:
Pupulala basinkombe,
Baimb’ amuzyale mwama
Ansi ano luse, bwanga, Leza wakwatila bantu.
Masi oonse naatangale, Bezeulu batembaule
Toonse tukanane Jesu, Mwana owa-Betelehemu.

Kristo Mwami wezeulu
Kristo Mwami wasikwense
Muteelele mbwakasika,
Mbwaakazyalwa buli uswe.
Leza watubulikila, Wasamikwa bo buzani
Wakalamwa kuba aswe, Syezeulu tuli aze.

Sekelela Sicibanda,
Bululami bumunika
Toonse twaletelwa buumi,
Kuliboonse ngu-Muponyi.
Bwami wabusamununa, Kuti akatande lufu,
Basumpulwe bana insi, Okuzyalwa olwabili.

Muzandisi owamasi
Kalilila muliuswe
Tanda bubi kulindiswe,
Tukabe mbuubele uwe.
Sibi siziminganyiwe Syoonse nsituteelele
Tube basiswezya-mozo, Obakala mulufuno.

choruses.text:
Pupulala basinkombe
Baimb’ amuzyale mwana.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Amba Makani aa-Jesu
items.original: TELL ME THE STORY OF JESUS
verses:
Amba makani aa-Jesu
Lemba majwi mumoyo;
Amba makani mabotu
Manono tanamvwidwe.
Amba baangelo munyimbo
Kuti Jesu wazyalwa,
Botelwa Leza mupati
Luumuno lubotu.

Wakakala mulukula,
Amba mazub’ ensiku;
Mbwakasunkwa zibi zyesu,
Mukugola wazunda.
Amba milimo ya-Jesu,
Amba kupenga kwakwe;
Wasampulwa mukupenga,
Takwe kupona kabotu.

choruses.text:
Amba makani aa-Jesu
Lemba mumoya wangu;
Amba makani mabotu
Manono tanamvwidwe.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Muvuni Wangu
verses:
Ndilaimba a-Muvuni,
Aluyando uluyoosya,
Wakafwid’ aciingano,
Kuti boonse bafutulwe.

Ndilaimba a-Muvuni,
Aluzyalo lwakwe loonse,
Eno ndili wakwe Jesu,
Oyo ‘wakandinununa.

Ndilaimba a-Muvuno,
Azyo Nguzu zyakwe ‘mpati,
Wakazund’ alufu lwakwe,
Wabusigwa akubafu.

Ndilaimba a-Muvuni,
Alo lufutuko lwakwe,
Ndakapegwa moyo mupya
Wakucisya ziluleme.

choruses.text:
Imba, imba a-Muvuni,
Wandivuna abulowa,
Wandifwid’ aciingano,
Jesu wandyaangulula.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Mwaangululi Wakasika
verses:
Mwaangululi wesu
Wakasika ano,
Imyoyo yesu
Yabotelwa, yati:

Toonse Twabotelwa
Akubusyu bwakwe,
Atubweede kwakwe,
Akwiita kwakwe.

Twakapulwa nguwe
Mwaangululi wesu,
Twabotelwa nguwe
Amyoyo yesu.

‘Limwe utwaambila
Aluzyalo lwakwe,
Ulatwiitila
Akujulu lyakwe.

choruses.text:
Mwaangululi wakasika,
Mwaangululi wakasika,
Mwaangululi twam’teele…la,
Twam’teelela.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Nguuli Mukwesu Ombuli Jesu?
verses:
Nguuli mukwesu ombuli Jesu?
Tawo pe, tawo pe,
Uti silike malwazi eesu?
Tawo pe, tawo pe.

Tawo aumbi uutufutula,
Tawo pe, tawo pe,
Umbi uujisi inguzu zyoonse,
Tawo pe, tawo pe.

Mpali Mukristo ngwaakasiya?
Tawo pe, tawo pe,
Sena wabona ngwaakakaka?
Tawo pe, tawo pe.

Kwina mukwesu uuinda Jesu,
Tawo pe, tawo pe,
Oyo uutusindikila lyoonse,
Tawo pe, tawo pe.

choruses.text:
Jesu uzi kupenga kwesu,
Ulatweenzya tukasike,
Nguuli mukwesu ombuli Jesu,
Tawo pe, tawo pe.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Nguni Uwakaseluka?
verses:
Nguni uwakabambulwa?
Jesu, Mufutuli;
Ngun’ ino utulungila?
Jesu, Mufutuli.

Nguni oy’ utujatila?
Jesu, Mufutuli;
Nguni uteeti, “Kosyoma?”
Jesu, Mufutuli.

Nguni Mukamwini bwami?
Jesu, Mufutuli;
Nguni utukombelela?
Jesu, Mufutuli.

Kuno sena uciboola?
Ii, mbwaakaamba;
Sena tulaba awalo?
Ii, mbwaakaamba.

choruses.text:
Atulumbe toonse,
Tumulemye Jesu,
Kwina umbi mbuli nguwe,
Jesu, Mufutuli.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Wakacitanzi Jesu Na?
verses:
Wakacitanzi Jesu na?
Wakaboola ansi ano,
Wasiya muunzi okuya
Kuti ndikajane buumi.

Wandicitilanzi ino?
Wandigwisya kukubisya,
Wajananzi’no? Kwina, pe!
Wakwelelwa ‘kubambulwa.

Ukala kuli asunu?
Wakabweeda kuli-Wisi,
Uyooboola alimwi na?
Ii, abulemu bwakwe.

Nditectinzi anguwe na?
Ndati, ulandilongezya!
Ndiyoomubona okuya,
Njoomulemya ciindi coonse.

Mulamuziba buyani ?
Amweempe, ‘mucililie !
Takonzya kumukasya pe,
Amufwambe ‘mutambule.

choruses.text:
Ngooyu Jesu, ngooyu Jesu,
Ngo-Mwami uuyandika,
Undipa lukono oko;
Kubusena ubusweya.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Wakasika Musilisi
verses:
Wakasika Musilisi
Uusilika myoyo yesu,
Wakaselukila kunsi,
Nguwe Mwan’ aa-Leza wesu.

Wakaenda koonse koonse,
Akumyunzi minjiminji,
Wakaponya bantu boonse,
Amalwazi waabusya.

Swebo tatuna kubona
Jesu oyo uusilika,
Kwalo nkwali kuya sunu,
Nkotuyeeya kuswaangana.

Katuya ku-Musilisi,
Ulatutanbula toonse,
Atukombe, tusinizye,
Jesu ulatwiingula.

choruses.text:
Mufutuli wakasika,
Mufutuli wabo boonse,
Mufutuli wakasika,
Mufutuli wabo boonse.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Buumi Bwakwe
items.title: Jesu, Mwami Jesu

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Lufu Lwakwe
items.title: Teelelesya Cinicini (Cila)
verses:
Teelelesya cinicini
Mbwaakeziza Jesu;
Nkalekale katufwini,
Uli Simuzeesu.

Wakazyalwa ansi ano,
Leza wazumina;
Swebo twakayanda maanu,
Ncotwamuzumina.

Waseluka kusilika
Babo bafwa myozo;
Kwakwe tulitambikile
Obulwazi bwesu.

Waseluka kufutula
Boonse obapenga;
Kweza kwakwe umusyome,
Ulaya mubuumi.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Lufu Lwakwe
items.title: Jesu Undibambisye
verses:
Jesu undibambisye,
Munsi aciingano,
Awo wakamwayika,
Mwiinzo wa-Kalvari.

Ndime aciingano,
Ndibone zilonda;
Amaanza amaulu,
Mpowakayasigwa.

Ndime aciingano,
Mukulumba kwangu,
Kuli Jesu akaambo,
Wakandifutula.

Ndilange kuciingano,
Akusyoma lyoonse,
Mane ‘nsike kunyika,
Kwital’ amulonga.

choruses.text:
Muvuni, Muvuni,
Ndijatilile,
Knaambo wakandiyanda,
Nendali mubisyi,

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Lufu Lwakwe
items.title: Acilundu Kule
verses:
Aciingano, canyansigwa nyika,
Mwami Jesu Mwana wa-Leza;
Bulemu bwakwe wakabusiya
Kuunka ku-Kalvari.

Aciingano ciyandwa abanji,
Ndabona kasimpe kakwe;
Kuciingano Jesu wakapenga
Kuti andipe lufutuko.

Kuciingano ndiyoosyomeka,
Ndiyootambula kuusa;
Uyakundiita kumuunzi mubotu,
Nkaabilwe bulemu bwakwe.

choruses.text:
Njakulemeka ciingano,
Limwi nkamupe bulumbu;
Njakujata ciingano cakwe,
Njakuusinta umusini.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Lufu Lwakwe
items.title: Mumwiinzo Wamalowa (Cila)
verses:
Mumwiinzo wamalowa
Uvwila ku-Kalvari,
Basibi obasamba
Boonse basalaziwa;
Mufumpi owa kale
Watangilila ko,
Mbu ndakozyana aze,
Nkandasanzyiwa mo.

Musamu wamyozo,
No nguni usabwila ?
No ome? Pe! Nduuzanda,
Mbwimbaazya kusofwala;
Babo bakwizeulu,
Balangilila mo,
Bazowa, batembaula Lufuno luli ko.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kubuka Kwakwe
items.title: Mwami Wes’ Ulibukile (Cila)
verses: Mwami wes’ ulibukile, Aleluya!

Ndulona ulwiimbo lwesu, Aleluya!
Atumulumbisye Jesu, Aleluya!
Oyo ‘wakazunda lufu. Aleluya!

Umulimo walondoka, Aleluya!
Usunu ndulufutuko, Aleluya!
Bezeulu balalumba, Aleluya!
Aswe abaansyi ano. Aleluya!

Lufu talukwe kutizya, Aleluya!
Jesu uliluzundile, Aleluya!
Aswe toonse tumusyome, Aleluya!
Aswe tuvunwe kundulo. Aleluya!

Ijulu lili bukwazi, Aleluya!
Mumo mwaakenjila Jesu, Aleluya!
Bantu boonse balatambwa, Aleluya!
Abalo benjile mumo. Aleluya!

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kubuka Kwakwe
items.title: Ucipona Jesu
verses:
Ulapona Jesu eno
Taluciyooweki lufu,
Ulapona Jesu eno
Tocijisi nguzu ocuumbwe.

Ulapona Jesu eno
Wazwa kulinduwe ocuumbwe,
Kwalo kufwa ngomulyango
Wakunjila mubuumi.

Ulapona Jesu eno
Wafwida milandu yesu,
Tumuponene lyoonse,
Tumulemye uululeme.

Ulapona Jesu eno,
Tatucaandanu anguwe,
Tulapona naba twafwa,
‘Twalulamikwa aa-Jesu.

Ulapona Jesu eno,
Alele koonse koonse,
Tuye kulinguwe, tulyookezye,
Akulela anguwe mubwami.

choruses.text: Aleluya, Aleluya, Aleluya, Amen.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kubuka Kwakwe
items.title: Ulilede Jesu
verses:
Ulilede Jesu uli mucuumbwe,
Uli mumudima Mufutuli.

Bamulindilila Jesu Mwami wesu,
Bajatisya cuumbwe pele tamo.

Bakafwa insoni bayiwa bakwe,
Eno balakondwa boonse boonse.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kubuka Kwakwe
items.title: Aleluya

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Bulemu Bwakwe
items.title: Noonse Mutangale, Wakasika Muvuni (Cila)
verses: Noonse mutangale, wakasika Muvuni,
Ngu-Jesu uvuna boonse bamusyoma.

Noonse mutangale, wakasika Mumuni,
Wamana musinze, mwakala mwituba.

Noonse mutangale, inzyo mulipaswilwe,
Nkukaako nkwezila owakamufwila.

Noonse mutangale, wakatolwa kulufu,
Anu Kaluzunda, wabonwa olimwi.

Noonse mutangale, wakabweela kwa-Usi,
wamweenzelela mucuuno cabwami.

Noonse mutangale, ulazyoka olimwi,
Uleza obwami, bulemu, obwanga.

choruses.text:
Aleluya, nalemekwe,
Inguwe Muyaye
Aleluya, naimbilwe,
Usunu ngu-Muumi.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Bulemu Bwakwe
items.title: Nkwali Uubaazyisya Banji (Cila)
verses: Nkwali uubaazisya banji,

Ulinfwini;
Nguwabaazy’ abo balongo,
Ulinfwini;
Balatwiimbizya kanji,
Kono limwi, koko linji,
Anu walo tatucengi,
Ulinfwini.

Kuyanan’ aze mbubuumi,
Ulinfwini;
Langa mbwaakatulongezya,
Ulinfwini;
Wiina ukatusampaula,
Wakeza kutulangaula,
Ukwa-Leza wazyolaula,
Ulinfwini.

Sa muzanda kumwiziba?
Ulinfwini;
Nguwe Jesu, Mwan’ aa-Leza,
Ulinfwini;
Osyakale musilube,
Musileke sicitilwe,
Zeni noonse mucilile,
Ulinfwini.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Bulemu Bwakwe
items.title: Jesu Muvuni Utufutula (Cila)
verses:
Jesu Muvuni utufutula,
Mwanakwe Leza utupasula;
Lufuno lwako lwatukwatila,
Insana syako satuzulila.

Twakuwizuka ulatulela,
Twatupauka ulakobela;
Babo balila ulabasozya,
Abo bapenga wabatontozya.

Wakatukuka obamininwe,
Waangulula obaangilwe;
Ndiwena Jesu Sinsana-syoonse,
Ndiwe Mukwesu mazuba oonse.

Bulemu boonse bulaba bwako,
Mikumo yoonse ilaba yako;
Atulibonzye ku-Mwami wesu,
Atube bakwe, Usimuzeesu.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuboola Kwakwe
items.title: Nobaya Kwiitwa Boonse
items.original: WHEN THE TOLL IS CALLED UP YONDER
verses:
Niiyoolila mpeta kuya kumakumbi aakujulu,
Nacasika ciindi cakumana kwensi,
Nabasyomi boonse babungana kuli-Jesu Mwami,
Nobaya kwiitwa boonse, njooba ko.

Kuliceeco ciindi nababuka boonse baka-fwide
‘AbaKristo bayoob’ akupona kupya,
Basalidwe nobaya kuswaanganyigwa kuli-Jesu,
Nobaya kwiitwa boonse, njooba ko.

Ciindi coonse tukamumanine imilimo Mwami,
Atwaambilane aluyando lwakwe,
Mbube kwaakumana ukukala kwesu kwa ‘nsi ano,
Nobaya kwiitwa bonse, njooba ko.

choruses.text:
Nobaya . . . kwiitwa boonse,
Nobaya . . . kwiitwa boonse,
Nobaya . . . kwiitwa boonse,
Nobaya kwiitwa boonse, njooba ko.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuboola Kwakwe
items.title: Kufutulwa aa-Bwanga
verses:
Ciindi cimwi ‘nyika iyoomana,
Mbube nsiciyooyimbi limbi;
Ndiyoobotelwa mubusena
Bwa-Leza Mwami wesu!

Ciindi cimwig’anda iyoowa,
Nsikonzya kwaamba mbwiiyooba,
Pele eci ncenzyi cilike
Ujisi busena bwangu!

Ciindi cimwi ‘zuba lyabbila,
Kunze amakumb’ asalala;
Mwami wangu uyoobotelwa,
Kunditambula kujulu.

Ciindi cimwi ndiyoolangila,
‘Lambe lyangu lyamwekesya,
Mwami akujula mulyango,
Muuya wangu uyoolyookezya.

choruses.text:
Ndiyoobona busyu bwakwe,
Kuyoowamba kufutulwa;
Ndiyoobona busyu bwakwe,
Kuyoowamba kufutulwa.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuboola Kwakwe
items.title: Tuyoobona Mwami
verses:
Na inzila yesu
Ilatuba bu,
Tuyoobona Mwami;
Na makumbi eesu
Alakupetuka,
Tuyoobona Mwami.

Kwaakumana koonse
Ukuciswa kwesu,
Tuyoobona Mwami;
Kwaakumana koonse
Akupenga kwesu,
Tuyoobona Mwami.

Sinkondonokwesu
Ulazundwa boonse,
Tuyoobona Mwami;
Tutalangi ansi,
Jesu ulabona,
Tuyoobona Mwami.

Oko kubafunwa
Abainka kale,
Toyoobona Mwami;
Kutangala kwakwe
Kulatubotezya,
Tuyoobona Mwami.

choruses.text:
Tuyoobona Mwami,
Tuyoobona Mwami;
Tuswaangane toonse
Mujulu omuya,
Tuyoobona Mwami.

items.title: Mubotezyi Wakasika
verses:
Mubuke nombungano muonenanzi na ?
Tamumumvwide no Muuya Mubotu,
Uli munyika eyi, twamutola sena,
Ngooyu Mubotezyi.

No kwakanka kuca kwatalika nkuko,
Oko ku-Pentekosti, kwamweeka kwa-ti mwe,
Bati mu-Jerusalemu balumba bat’ “ehe”
Ngooyu Mubotezyi.

Ii, mpali walo, awa mpali lino,
Tuzunde basinkondo boonse tukombe,
Atuzuzigwe swe, tubambwe kabotu,
Ngooyu Mubotezyi.

Asunu ulimvwi ulanguzu zyoonse,
Ulatusalazya tuya kutuba bu,
Fwambaana mweenzuma mutole kufwamba,
Ngooyu Mubotezyi.

choruses.text:
Ncoben’ ulimunyika; uzwida kujulu,
Uyakusanzya koonse okuli mumyoyo,
Tuya kutuba bu, twasamba sena na ?
Ngooyu Mubotezyi.

items.title: Kounga, Muuya Uwabuumi (Cila)
verses:
Kounga, Muuya uwabuumi,
Ubusye abafwide,
Ubaumne umukunga,
Bakazileke zibi.

Ubatondezye mbobabede,
Babone imiiandu,
Ukuti bazibisya mbeta,
Zya-Leza Usinguzu.

Ubaambile aluzyalo
Bakalutambulisye,
Bateelelesye Ivangele,
Ukuti bakapone.

Amo mumyoyo yesu yoonse,
Kounga ciindi coonse,
Tujane buumi bupya, Mwami,
Ubuumi butamani.

items.title: Kondizuzya Eno
verses:
Nzuzya aa-Muuya
Mubotu Nakuba ndi mulwazi;
Pele ndakuyanda loko
Koboola undizuzye.

Ndi mubombe bombe mubi,
Ndooma ansi kukomba;
Muuya utamani boola,
Undizuzye luyando.

Nsanzya ntube, ndifutula,
Nkomanisya, ndeleka;
Nduwe undikomanisya,
Akuzuzya mumoyo.

choruses.text:
Koboola, koboola,
Undinjile mumoyo;
Kondizuzya nsetekane
Uzuzye moyo wangu.

items.title: Mfulila Moza Leza (Cila)
verses:
Mfulila Moza Leza,
Olimwi nzuzya buumi,
Nkafune syoonse nsyuufuna,
Syoonse nsyuucita, ncite.

Mfulila Moza Leza,
Nkasweye swe umozo,
Luzanda lwako lube lwangu
Kuncita na maciswe.

Mfulila Moza Leza,
Mbe wako walolona,
Mubili wangu ubekeme,
Mbundakanjilwa ndiwe.

Mfulila Mza Leza,
Nintakafwililili
Nkapone aze bulondosi,
Buumi obutakeeli.

items.title: Tulakuswaana ‘Mulonga
items.original: SHALL WE GATHER AT THE RIVER?
verses:
Tulakuswaana ‘mulonga
Nkobaenda baangeo;
Meenda alaenda lyoonse,
Kucuuno cakwe Mwami.

Ankomwe yawo mulonga,
Meenda alamwekesya;
Tulakwenda mukulumba,
Buzuba butamani.

Notutaninga sik’ oko,
Tulatula mikuli;
Luse lulakutuvuna,
Tulapegwa misini.

Tulakufwamba kusika,
Musinzo ulamana;
Myoyo ilakusek’ oko,
Lwiimbo lwakuumuna.

choruses.text:
Tulakuswaana ’mulonga,
Kumulonga mubotu mubotu,
Tuswaangane abaslidwe,
Kumulonga wa-Leza

items.title: Sena Ndililembedwe Mo?
verses:
Ulubono nsiyandi, ndawakaindi kasyoonto
Ndilayanda kujulu, ndikanjile mumona;
MwiBbuku lyabuumi ilisalalisya,
Kondyaambila Jesu, sena ndalembwa mo?
Sena ndalembwa mo ?
Sena ndalembwa mo ?
MwiBbuku lyabuumi,
Sena ndililembedwe ?

„Zibi zyangu zyavula, zyali mbuli musenga
Ubulowa bwa-Jesu bwazisanzya zitube;
Cisyomezyo ca-Mwami cilandibotezya;
“Zibi zyako na nzinji, zyoonse zyatuba bu.”
Ii, ndalembwa mo,
Jesu nguwandilemba,
MwiBbuku lyabuumi,
Ii ndililembedwe.

Muunzi oyo mubotu ul’ amaanda aabambwa,
Bantu boonse banjila mbabo bakasa-nzigwa;
Takunjili ukubi ukubisya bubotu,
Nkobalinda baangelo, ii, ndililwmbwsqw.
Ii, ndalembwa mo,
Jesu nguwandilemba,
MwiBbuku lyabuumi,
Ii ndililembedwe.

items.title: Nkamuzyibe
verses:
Ndamana milimo yangu yoonse munyika eyi,
Njakusamikwa mubili utafwi,
Elyo njakumuziba Mufutuli kabotu,
Uyakundiciinga cakukomana.

Ndiya kukomana abusyu bwakwe bwakuu-muna
Ameso akwe alaluse lunji;
Ndiya kumulumbaizya wakandiyandisya,
Akundibambila g’anda yabwami.

Bayandika bangu twakaandana kaindi,
Mubuumi bubotu bwa-Mwami Jesu;
Tatukaandani mumabanda aa-Edeni,
Pele ntaangune mbone Mufutuli.

Nkanjile mumuunzi nkesamine zituba bu,
Akandijinzye mutalili bantu,
Lwiimbo alutamani ndiya kwiimba ambabo,
Pele ntaangune mbone Mufutuli.

choruses.text:
Kamuzyibe, nkamuzyibe,
Ndakwiima munsi lyakwe Jesu;
Nkamuzyibe, nkamuzyibe,
Ainembo mumaanza akwe.

items.title: Netusika Kujulu
items.original: WHEN WE ALL GET TO HEAVEN
verses:
Imba luyando lwa-Jesu
Imba luzyalo lwakwe,
Kumuunzi wakwe mubotu,
Ulabamba cilao.

Netweenda mulweendo lwansi,
Mayoba alasiya;
Pele na lweendo lwamana,
Takwe mudima oko.

Atusyomeke kasimpe,
Akuzumina lyoonse;
Akumubona kujulu,
Kuyootupa kukondwa.

choruses.text:
Twaakusika kujulu,
Buzuba bwakukondwa okuya;
Twaakubona Jesu tulaimba,
Tulaimba luzundo.

items.title: Tuzoolumba Mwami Jesu
items.original: WE SHALL STAND BEFORE THE KING
verses:
1. Tuzoolumba Mwami Jesu,
Tuzoobona busyu bwakwe
Caba ciindi, caba ciindi,
Tuzooenda ‘nzila yakwe,
Tuzoobona bafutulwa,
Twabotelwa, twabotelwa.

choruses.text:
Tuzooima kumbele kwakwe,
Tuzoolumba Mwami Jesu,
Tuzoolumba Mwami Jesu,
Aleluya! Aleluya!
Tuzoolumba Mwami Jesu.
2. Tuzoomwiimbila Jesu
Nkaambo kaluzyalo lwakwe,
Caba ciindi, caba ciindi,
Tuzootembaula Jesu
Nkaambo kakuyanda kwakwe,
Twabotelwa, twabotelwa.
3. Oko takubonwa lufu,
Pele buumi butamani,
Caba ciindi, caba ciindi,
Tuyoolya micelo yakwe,
Twabotelwa, twabotelwa.

items.title: Mulyango Wakujwe
verses:
Njookuswaana icifumo,
Mumulyango wakujwe;
Kolibamba we silweendo,
‘Kuti uutamuki.

Na ulaya kubulemu,
Lind’ amulyango akujwe;
Ndilasika icifumo,
Yebo uutalindi.

Amusonse amalampi,
Mulindile Nacibinde;
Ulabaswe icifumo,
Mumulyango wakujwe.

Mubuzub’ obo bubotu,
Natwaswaana abasweya;
Kuyoobota buti kuuya,
Mumulyango wakujwe.

choruses.text:
Njookuswaana icifumo,
Mumulyango wakujwe okuya,
Njookuswaana icifumo,
Njookuswaana cifumo okuya.

items.title: Mbunono Ncobeni
items.original: THERE’S A LAND THAT IS FAIRER
verses:
Kujulu kwa-Leza Mubumbi,
Baibele litubuzya muunzi;
Basweeki, bazibi kamuza,
Ncobeni kubuumi bubotu.

Tuzoonjila twaimba nyimbo,
Inyimbo zyakukondwa loko;
Mapenzi, mafwabi twasiye,
‘Tugame kuimba zya-Leza.

Malwazi, misozi taziko,
Pele kukondwa lyoonse lyoonse;
Ntolongo enzala taziko,
Pele kukuta lyoonse lyoonse.

Taata ulatulindila ‘ko,
Ulatucitila zibbula;
Atutembule Jesu toonse,
Kukondwa kwansi kulamana.

choruses.text:
Mbunono ncobeni,
Eneeno fwaambana mweenzuma;
Mbunono but’ ambwi
Fwaambana usike kwa-Leza.

items.title: Akale
verses:
Kanjikanji twatandwa alwenje lwamapenzi Iguwo
lilainda kuboola kwezuba kanji, Kumuunzi
mupya oko, na ingubi yatolwa, Tuya kutelela oko
akale.

Tulapenga kanjikanji azintu zyabuumi
Twafwa nzala, twafwa nyota, kwina kulya kubotu;
Tulamusyoma Mwami mbubonya mbuli ijwi,
Tuya kuteelela oko akale.

Tulasunkwa lyoonse, tatumvwide kabotu, Inzila
yoonse ya-Leza nkwaya kutusolo-lela,
Nawatusololela tuya kumutobela,
Tuya kuteelela oko akale.

Tatuzi ciindi cibi ca-Saatani ncaboola,
Miyeeyo yesu ilalila natazundi cibi;
Twakankamana buti natwaalilwa kuzunda,
Tuya kuteelela oko akale.

choruses.text:
Akale, cifumofumo,
Ba-Kristo basika kumuunzi;
Tuya kwaamba kuzunda kwesu,
Tuya kutelela oko akale.

items.title: Julu, Muunzi Wangu
verses:
Julu, muunzi wangu !
Ndakuyanda mebo,
Julu, muunzi wangu !
Wacitilwa ndime.
Julu, muunzi wangu !
Wayakilwa toonse,
Ul’ aa-Taata wangu,
Ul’ aa-Mwami wangu.

Julu, muunzi wangu !
Ndakaulwa mebo
Julu, muunzi wangu !
Ul’ abuumi bwangu;
Nandalanga ansi,
Zyoonse zilamana;
Twatambula zyako,
Zitamani eno.

Ul’ abuumi bwangu,
Buumi butamani,
Ubatecembaalwa,
Ubutasofwaali.
Julu, muunzi wangu !
Kubuvubi bwangu,
Nkokubotu, Mwami,
Ukusweya kwako.

items.title: Busyu Kubusyu
verses:
Tuyoobona busyu bwakwe,
Busyu bwa-Jesu Mwami,
Abulemu bwakujulu,
Twakukala Mwa-Tatta.

Tatukwe netwakabona,
Twakaswiilila buyo,
Pele busiku bwasika,
Tuyoobona kabotu.

Buzuba bwakubotelwa,
Tuyoobona bulemu,
Zintu zibi ziyoomana,
Muyoosyaala zibotu.

Busyu kubusyu bwa-Jesu,
Tuyoobonana kuya;
Tuyoomulanga, Jehova,
Jesu Mwami mupati.

choruses.text:
Tuyoobona busyu bwakwe,
Tukalangane awe;
Abulemu bwakwe boonse,
Tuyoobona kujulu.

items.title: Ijwi Talimani
verses:
Ijwi talimani,
Lilasololela,
Lilababotezya
Abasyoma ndilyo.

Na kwasika impi
Iya kutulwisya,
Ijwi lilayovwa,
Lilatufutula.

Naaba kulasiya,
Tutaboni cintu,
Ijwi lilaleezya
Akumweka kwalyo.

Kwina uti ambe,
‘Kubotelwa koonse
Kuya kulimbabo
Abalanga ndilyo.

Ndyaluzyalo lyalo,
Naaba tucipona,
Naaba tukalafwa,
Lilayovwa lyoonse.

Mwami, tupe swebo,
Ukulitambula,
Twiisigwe ndilyo,
Uliyandisisye.

items.title: Mazwi Aakwe Leza Mwini (Cila)
verses:
Mazwi aakwe Leza Mwini
Ngamu-Baibele
||Lilizwile omakani
Avwa kulinguwe.||

Inkombelo sya-Mukristo
Syoonse sili momo
||Nsyavumina onsyacita
Silabalwa mumo.||

Twakabula kuteelela luse
lwakwe Jesu
||Inzyo tulalibwezela
Mwi-Baibele lyesu.||

Buumi bwakwe Moza Mwini
Mbubwabantu boonse
||Bulasika ubwasunu,
Atubutambule.||

Mazwi aya tuwajate,
Alatulongezya
||Twateelele ciindi coonse,
NdiBaibele lyesu.||

items.title: Majwi Akabotezya

choruses.text: ||Abotezya, ’kantamika, majwi alufutuko.||

items.title: Lufutuko Mdulukando (Cila)
verses:
Lufutuko ndulukando
Ndwaakapewa masi
Kubulowa obwa-Jesu,
Obwakunkil’ ansi.

Lufutuko ndulukando,
Lufutula boonse
Buumi nwalo mbubukando,
Mbwamyaaka yoonse.

Lufutuko ndulukando,
Lutusumpulisya
Tube bakwe balye zina,
Leza Uusweyisya.

Mwamukakilanzi Mwami,
Leza Mufutuli?
Kwina unji Mununuzi,
Mwami wa-Bulemu.

items.title: Jesu Uvuna
Coolwe Cipati
verses:
Coolwe cipati cileza,
Teelela ulatusyomya;
Kuyoozwide uluzyalo,
Uboole ukutuyovwa.

Coolwe cipati cileza,
Ciyootusinsimunisya;
Muuya wawida ombuli
’Mvula impati iiyoosya.

Coolwe cipati cileza,
Acituwide bwasunu;
Mwami koboola tuyovwe,
Boola eno, Mufutuli.

Coolwe cipati cileza,
Ciindi cibotu ncasunu;
Zibi zyaboonse zivumbwe,
Jesu koboola, koboola.

choruses.text:
Coolwe cipati,
Coolwe cipati cileza;
Luse lulatusikila,
Luse tulalulilila.

items.title: Tuli Beenzu Ansi Ano (Cila)
verses:
Tuli beenzu ansi ano,
Tuli boofu, twiina mano
Inzyo sunu tukumbile
Jesu atusindikile.

Bausyeesu obakale
Bakabula Mufutuli
Kabatana kuteelela
Ati Jesu wabafwila.

Kabacili mumusinze,
Kabakwete omapenzi
Nibakaya kupaila,
Cinzi nciba-kukapula?

Baya kukapula nsana,
Kabatana kusiyana
Mizimo yalengauka,
Abo bantu basanduka.

Balakomba Leza Mwini,
Mwami wesu utufwini
Buumi bwesu buvwa kwakwe,
Atubambe mbeta syakwe.

items.title: Ncinzi Cinsanzisya ’Tombe? (Cila)
items.original: NOTHING BUT THE BLOOD OF JESUS
verses:
Ncinzi cinsanzisya ’tombe?
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu;
Nkukwi nkwinkapuulushiwa?
Pele jubulowa bwa-Jesu.

Sibi syaziminganyiwa,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu;
Bubyaabi bwakwatilwa,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu.

Ncicibanda olufuno,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu;
Bululami kwina kono,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu.

Nubapengi mwize noonse,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu;
Tubasibi aswe toonse,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu.

choruses.text:
Mbuzandisi bo bulowa,
Bunsanzi sya nsweye swe;
Mwiinzo unji tonabwenwe,
Pele kubulowa bwa-Jesu.

items.title: Ukufutulwa Nkubotu
verses:
Ukufutulwa ! Nkubotu
Amu matwi eesu !
Nkaambo twaangululwa nkuko
Mukubisya kwesu.

Kale twali kusweekede
Mukubisya kwesu,
Kwalo eno twaangululwa
Mumapenzi eesu.

Ukufutulwa kulumbwe
Akumasi oonse,
Akujulu kulalumbwa
Embangano zyoonse.

choruses.text:
Mumulemye, mumulemye,
Siluzyalo mumulemye, Aleluya! Aleluya!
Akulumbwe Mufutuli!

items.title: Watolwa
verses:
Ndauyeeya mukuli nowakazwa,
Ndauyumuna ciindi cupati,
Ndalangaula Leza,
Ndasyoma majwi akwe,
Ndilyona mukuli wakazwa.

Ndakayeeya mukuli nowakazwa,
Mdakayowa takwe kundisiya;
Jesu wanditondezya, Ciingano calufu,
Ndabotelwa mukuli wakazwa.

Ndilizi kuti mukuli wakazwa,
Wakandipenzya lyoonse;
Kucuuno caluzyalo,
Ndakamubona Jesu,
Ndilyona mukuli wakazwa.

Ndaimba limwi mukuli wakazwa,
Nkokuli lwimbo mukuli wakazwa;
Ndijiai Mwami wangu,
Wandipa buumi bwakwe,
Aleluya ! Mukuli wakazwa.

choruses.text:
Watolwa, watolwa,
Ndabotelwa kuti mukuli wazwa;
Watolwa, watolwa,
Ndabotelwa na mukuli wakazwa.

items.title: Ndilaimba Amalweza (Cila)
verses:
Ndilaimba amalweza,
Mbwaakamfwila Jesu Mwini,
Mbwaakasiya kwizeulu,
Mbwaakasika ansi ano.

Ndakakozya imbelele,
Ndali kusweekele bulyo
Walo wakanzinzilika,
Wakanzyola kwakwe Mwini.

Ndawizuka, wandilela,
Ndafwa nyota, wanwinsya
Ndasimbalwa, wambotezya,
Okupenga, wandivuna.

Onwasunu tuli aze,
Ulanyenzya ’nzila yoonse
Buumi boonse ndamusyoma,
Takandiimbizya ome.

Ndilaimba amalweza,
Nduse lwakwe Jesu Mwami
Ndilaimba olufuno,
Bolya mbwaakandifutula.

choruses.text:
Ndilaimba amalweza,
Mbwaakamfwila Jesu Mwini,
Mbwaakasiya kwizeulu,
Mbwaakamfwil’ a-Kalvari.

items.title: Ndanununwa
verses:
Ndayanda kukambaukilwa,
Mbondafutuka bulowa;
Ndafutuka aluse lwakwe,
Ndaanguluka bunene.

Jesu ulandikomansiya,
Kukomanisya kupati,
Ndizi kuti kumweka kwakwe
Kuya kukala andime.

Ndayeeya Mufutuli wangu,
Zuba lyoonse ndamuyeeya;
Ndilaimba nsikaumuni
Kwiimba luyando lwakwe.

Ndaziba ndiya kumubona
Mwami oyo undiyanda;
Ulandisololela koonse
Akundibamba maiku.

choruses.text:
Ndili wakwe,
Ndibe wakwe kutamani;
Ndili wakwe,
Ndibe wakwe kutamani.

items.title: Atumwiimbile Jesu (Cila)
verses:
Atumwiimbile Jesu,
Kuti ’nguwe ngu-Muvuni;
Atumwiimbile Jesu,
Okumazwi okumyozo.
Uswe twali kusweekele,
Imbelele siteembelwa
Uswe twali kusweekele,
Jesu katulangaula.

Naakafwa acilundu,
Obulowa buzandika
Naakafwa acilundu,
Katuula cabuzumo.
Muteelele, ulamwiita,
Umwe noonse mukatele,
Muteelele, ulamwiita,
Ati, “Ndikalamaponya”.

Uswe atuwile ansi,
Atubebe tuvumine
Uswe atuwile ansi,
Atubombe kulinguwe.
Sena kulayanwa kwani,
Manga aakozyan’ aa-Jesu?
Sena kulayanwa kwani,
Luse olukozya lwakwe?

items.title: Mwaala Wang’ Uuteeli (Cila)
verses:
Mwaala wang’ uuteeli,
Ntiye nzube knwako
Meenzi omalowa azo
Akavwila kuliuwe
Ngumusamu wangu
Unsilika mozo.

Milimo njimana
Tekulamya, Mwami
Naaba mail ngwinkaleta,
Niiba ’nsoni njingusila
Pele luse lwako
Lumpasula sibi.

Ndeza kwako bulyo
Ndiina ncinkaleta
Ndalifwika, kwako Mwami,
Nswezya, ndime mubyaabi
Unyenzanye Jesu,
’Nsanzye mozo ntube bu.

items.title: Aciingano ca-Jesu
verses:
Aciingano ca-Jesu Mwami
Aciingano cibiabi,
Watutilila bulowa bwakwe
Atumulemye.

Sunu ndili acoolwe cakwe,
Jesu wakala mulindime,
Wandibotezya iciindi coonse,
Atumulemye.

Bazibi, nyoonse amutelele
Amuzisanzye zibi zyanu,
Boola ku-Jesu mujane coolwe
Atumulemye.

choruses.text:
Atumulemye, atumulemye,
Watutilila bulowa bwakwe,
Atumulemye.

items.title: Buzuba Bwakukomana
verses:
Buzuba bwakukomana
Nondakakusala, Jesu,
Moyo wangu ulelede,
Kubaambila bantu boonse.

Nkwasimpila, nkwasimpila,
Ndili wakwe, uli wangu;
Wandikwela, ndcilila,
Ndakakomana kwiitwa.

Kolyookezya moyo wangu,
Koyeeya Mwami wazyoonse;
Utaandani aa-Leza,
Ulijisi zintu zyoonse.

items.title: Luyando Lwandibweza
verses:
Ndakabbila muzibi kule kuzwa Mwami,
Ndakeenda ababi, ndakawa musiya,
Pele Jesu wakamvwa kukulila kwangu,
Wakambweza kuzwa muzibi zyangu.

Ndamupa moyo wangu, ndilajatilila,
Ndipone mulinguwe, ndilalemya Jesu,
Mwami wangu mupati wakandifutula,
Mulimo usyomeka kulinguwe.

Atulange kujulu, nkoku-Mufutuli,
Uyoomubweza lino kuluyando lwakwe,
Zintu zyoonse zyanyika Mwami uyoozunda;
Mgo-Mufutuli wabo, bantu boonse.

choruses.text:
Ndakabwezwa, Ndakabwezwa,
Luyando lwa-Jesu lwandibweza.
Ndakabwezwa, Ndakabwezwa,
Luyando lwa-Jesu lwandibweza.

items.title: Mbwembede, Mwami (Cila)
verses:
Mbwembede, Mwami, ndeza eno,
Nsijisi kulyaambilila,
Ndiyeeya pele mbondiita
Mwami Jesu ,ndaboola.

Mbwembede, Mwami, ndimupusi,
Ndimoofu, ndimulwazi,
mubi, Nkajane zyoonse kulinduwe
Mwami Jesu, ndaboola.

Mbwembede, Mwami, ndakakilwa,
Nsikonzya kuzisanzya zibi,
Mbulowa bwako bundisanzya
Mwami Jesu, ndaboola.

Mbwembede, Mwami, nditambula,
Kondijatila ziba zyangu,
Mfwida luzyalo, ndipa buumi
Mwami Jesu, ndaboola.

Mbwembede, Mwami, ndoluzyalo
Ulwandileta kulinduwe,
Ndalumba, Taata, ndili wako
Mwami Jesu, ndaboola.

items.title: Mwami, Aluzyalo Lwako
verses:
Mwami, aluzyalo lwako,
Bona oyu moyo wangu;
Ndakotama kulinduwe,
Gwisya zyoonse zibi zyangu.

Taata, kale ndakabisya,
Nsindalizi cibi cangu;
Muzibyaabi ndalifwide,
Gwisya zyoonse zibi zyangu.

Yebo, uli Siluzyalo,
Lyoonse wandikombelela;
Wakandiita-ndakakaka,
Gwisya zyoonse zibi zyangu.

Ndakamumvma Mufutuli
Uwatola cibi cangu;
Undiboozye-ndakatala,
Gwisya zyoonse zibi zyangu.

Jesu, ndeza kulinduwe,
Azyo zyoonse zibi zyangu;
Nditambula aluzyalo,
Gwisya zyoonse zibi zyangu.

items.title: Mwami Leza Ndimwanaako
verses:
Mwami Leza, ndimwanaako,
Kwalo ndakabisya;
Ndalila kumbele lyako,
Taata, ndijatila.

Akubisya kwangu koonse,
Takukooyoobalwa pe;
Ndakubika kulinduwe,
Taata, ndijatila.

’Milumbe yako ndiityola,
Yebo ndakunyansya;
’Lufutuko ndalusowa,
Taata, ndijatila.

Ndakabisy’ akukanana,
Ndabisya akuyeeya;
Ndakabisya amilimo,
Taata, ndijatila.

Amebo ndalikweelede,
Ukukulemeka;
Ndakabisya kukuluba,
Taata, ndijatila.

Izibi zyangu zyavula,
Taata, ndakabisya;
Ndakakusampaulisya,
Taata, ndijatila.

Mwami Leza, Siluzyalo,
’Lupati lutamani;
Nkaambo kaako ndilalila
Taata, ndijatila.

items.title: Ndazumina
verses:
Ndaimbisya amumoyo wangu,
Ijwi lyako, Mwami;
Mwami leka eno ndikubone,
Sena wazumina?

Ndafutuka amuluse lwako,
Lyoonse wandiyanda;
Kuli Kristo, ii, ndazumina,
Lyoonse undiyonwe.

Ulizi akulibombya kwangu,
Aboowa mbwenjisi;
’Nguzu zyangu zizwa kulinduwe,
Asunu undipe.

Mwami, boola uzoobape sunu,
Uluse akwiimba;
Toonse atwaambe ku-Mwami wesu,
Tube bana-Kristo.

Bakakumbila nowakal’ ano,
Mwami nawayanda;
Twamvwa boonse kabaamba obo,
Atukalilile.

choruses.text:
Ii, ii, ii, Leza ndigwasya
Ukuba wako;
Wandyula abulowa bwako,
Ii, ndibe wako.

items.title: Mwami Ndaboola
verses:
Ndakaya kule aa-Leza,
Eno ndaboola;
Ndainda munzila zibi,
Mwami ndaboola.

Ndakasowa myaaka minji,
Eno ndaboola;
Ndasanduka akulila,
Mwami ndaboola.

Ndakatala kukisiya,
Eno ndaboola;
Ndakusyom’ akuzumina,
Mwami ndaboola.

choruses.text:
Ndaboola, ndaboola,
Nsibwed’ alimwi;
Mwami, konditambula,
Mwami ndaboola.

items.title: Ndil’ Ezibi Zinjizinji
verses:
Ndil’ ezibi zinjizinji,
’Zindipenzya lyoonse,
Ndikapula Mufutuli,
Uufutula boonse.
Yebo Jesu, Yebo Jesu,
Nduwe Mufutuli wangu.

Wandiyanda, ndime mubi,
Watufwida toonse,
Nduwe wakandilungila
Umulandu woonse.
Yebo Jesu, Yebo Jesu,
Nduwe Mufutuli wangu

’Bululami nsibujisi,
Abusweyi boonse,
Swena Jesu, undisanzye,
Sanzya moyo woonse.
Yebo Jesu, Yebo Jesu,
Nduwe Mufutuli wangu.

Jesu, eno ndili wako,
Kondeyeenzya lyoonse,
Ndipa ’nguzu, nkucilile
Amunzila moonse.
Yebo Jesu, Yebo Jesu,
Nduwe Mufutuli wangu.

Oko kulinduwe, Mwami,
Tuyookala lyoonse,
Tunoolumbaizya Jesu
Kumaindi oonse.
Yebo Jesu, Yebo Jesu,
Nduwe Mufutuli wangu.

items.title: Uyanda Kuponena kwa-Jesu?
verses:
Sena ulayanda kuponena kwa-Jesu ?
Akumutobela munzila ince ?
Sena akuyumwine mukuli wako na ?
Muleke asolole.

Sena ulayanda kwangununwa sunu na ?
Sena uyanda kumvwa kuumuna kwakwe ?
Sena ulayanda akufutulwa sunu,
Kuti utabi nowa?

Sa uyanda kulyookezya mubwami bwa-kwe ?
Akuzibisya kusyomeka kwakwe ?
Sa uyanda kubelekela nguwe lyoonse ?
Muleke asolole.

choruses.text:
Inguzu zyakwe zyakwangununa,
Bulowa bwakwe bwakusalazya;
Luyando lwakwe lulakuzuzya,
Inzila yakwe nimbotu kwiinda.

items.title: Mwami, Sunu Ndalyaaba
verses:
Mwami, sunu ndalyaaba,
Nkabe wako ciindi coonse,
Tola koonse kube kwako,
Woonse moyo amubili.

Amatansyi uwatole,
Wabelesye kuli koonse;
Amatende, uwaenzye
Mumulimo wako, Mwami.

Amulak; awalo uambe
Uluyando lwako, Jesu,
Uompolole, ukaiye,
Ukalumbe ’zina lyako.

Ulubono lube lwako,
Eno talucili lwangu,
Kolutola, Jesu, sunu
Ako koonse kuli kwangu.

Aluyando lwangu tola,
Kolucita lube lwako,
Koonse takucili kwangu,
Ukutole, Mwami wangu.

items.title: Luyando Ulutandileki
verses:
Luyando ulutandileki,
Ndikalyookezye kulinduwe;
Mbwempegwa buumi ndabutula
Kumbele lyako, Mwami wangu,
Mobukazyulila!

Mumuni uutazimi lyoonse,
Ndimunikila nzila yangu;
Kamuni kangu takayovwi,
Nkaako ndimunikilwa nduwe
Ooli ’Zuba lyangu!

Ciband citamani lyoonse,
Utandisyi ciindi coonse;
Kokal’ amebo mumapenzi
Mane ndijane kubotelwa
Kulinduwe, Mwami!

Ociingano ncendapegwa,
Ndakutambula cakukondwa;
Eno ndaleka zintu zyoonse,
Nkajane kulinduwe, Mwami!
Buumi butamani!

items.title: Uyanda Kubota
verses:
Uyanda kubota, kaambe a-Mwami,
Kal’ awe lyoonse, akwiiya ijwi,
Uyanda ba-Jesu, gwasya batete,
Utalubi lyoonse kombela Mwami.

items.title: Jesu, Muvuni, Ndili Wako ’Like
verses:
Jesu, Muvuni, ndili wako ’like,
Ndilalipeda kulinduwe, Mwami;
Nsikwe cintu eno, Mwami uuyandika,
Koonse oku kwangu kube kwako, Taata.

Kale ndaleya, wakandyuusila,
Wakalyaaba, wandifwida, Mwami;
Eno endifutwidwe ndilabon’ inzila,
Njooteelela nduwe, Mufutuli wangu.

Koba amebo, kondivuna lyoonse,
Nkalelwe nduwe ooli Mwami lyoonse,
Na ayebo mpoli njoobotelwa lyoonse.
Nkaambo yebo, Mwami, uli nguzu zyangu.

’Luyando lwako lulandilweelela,
Mbokandifwida aluzyalo, Jesu;
Nsikoobona umbi uuyelen’ ayebo,
Amumoyo wangu kooneka, Mwami.

choruses.text:
Jesu, Mwami wangu, eno ndili wako,
’Yebo, ooyandika, uli wangu.

items.title: Ndakakupa Buumi
verses:
Ndakakupa buumi bwangu,
Bulowa bwatika,
Kuti ufutuke,
||Ndakakupa buumi bwangu,
Wakandipanz’ ino?||

Muunzi mubotu wa-Taata,
Bwami bwabulemu,
Ndasiya nkaambo kenyika,
Ndapenga endike,
||Ndasiya zyoonse nkaamba kako,
Wakandipanz’ ino?||

Ndakakweetla,
Kuzwa kumuumzi wangu,
Lufutuko lupati,
Kujatila kwangu,
||Ndakakweetela bwami,
Wakandipanz’ ino?||

items.title: Ponena Jesu
verses:
Ponena Jesu lyoonse !
Luse lwakwe lutamani;
Kuti nkasunkwe nsiyowi,
Ponena Jesu ula’ fwi.

Ponena Jesu lyoonse !
Kukomba Mwami, ndalelekwa;
Ndayanda buyo kuciya,
Luyando lwakwe lyoonse.

Ponena Jesu lyoonse !
Mikuli yangu yabwezwa;
Kumusyoma walo Mwami,
Uyoondisololela.

Ponena Jesu lyoonse !
Bulemu bwakwe nkajile;
Nkatelele majwi akwe,
“Njila mumuunzi, mwanangu.”

choruses.text:
Ndiyovwa kukumanina,
Kondiyovwa kukulumba’
Mpone ayebo lyoonse,
Nsikwe kuya kukusiya.

items.title: Alimwi aa-Jesu
verses:
Ndayandisya kumvwa alimwi
Luse aluyando lwakwe;
Alimwi waambile bamwi,
Luyando wakandifwida.

Alimwi ndilakuiya,
Ndizibe kusetekanya;
Leza Mwami kondiisya,
Kumuziba Jesu wangu.

Jesu mujwi twamuziba,
Twazuminana anguwe;
Ndatelela ijwi lyakwe,
Ndaambile bamwi anfuwe.

Alimwi aa-Jesu Mwami,
Acuuno cabwami cakwe;
Kambauka kaambo kakwe,
Akuboola kwabulelo.

choruses.text:
Alimwi aa-Jesu
Alimwi aa-Jesu;
Alimwi akufutuka,
Aluyando wandifwida.

items.title: Nkenaba Mbuli Jesu
verses:
Nkenaba mbuli Jesu
Uwali kulibonzya,
Nkenaba mbuli nguwe,
||Walo walibombede.||

Nkenaba mbuli Jesu,
Ndiyeeye mbwaakakomba
Alike mucilundu,
||Aa-Wisi mbwateelela.||

Nkenaba mbuli Jesu,
Amajwi aangu oonse
Amubotezye Mwami,
||Libombe ijwi lyangu.||

Nkenaba mbuli Jesu,
Kuncito zyangu zyoonse,
Ndimutobele Mwami
||Mukweenda kwangu koonse.||

Nkenaba mbuli Jesu
Nsoleke oko kwako,
Kwalo ame ndiyovwa
||Mane nkozyan’ ayebo.||

items.title: Cita Mboyanda
verses:
Cita mboyanda, Mwami Mubumbi,
Uli Mubumbi, ndili bulongo;
Mwami, ndibumba, mbuli mboyanda,
Mbwencilindila, Mwami Mubumbi.

Cita mboyanda, Mwami Musweyi,
Ulasalala, ndilisofweeede;
Kondisalazya mane nditube,
Mbwencifugama, Mwami Musweyi.

Cita mboyanda, Mwami Muyovwi,
Uli Singuzu, ndili mutete;
Mwami, ndiyovwa, mbuli mbwembula,
Ukandiyumye, Mwami Muyovwi.

Cita mboyanda, Mwami Singuzu,
Boola, ukale mumoyo wangu;
Nkakukozyanye, nkakulemeke,
Mbe wako ’like, Mwami Singuzu.

items.title: Taata, Nyenzya Nsiku Syoonse (Cila)
verses:
Taata, nyenzya nsiku syoonse,
Koonse nkwinkasika
Mbe musweyi uusinizya,
Ndeezya nsinkacita.

Nkwiili nzila iilumine,
Nzibya mbunfutula
Mbe muzumo mbwinkusyoma,
Nkale mukufunwa.

Sibi nisintepaula,
Mbe sinsana muuza
Sili bu musyaala mwana,
Ndiwe unsuntula.

Mozo wangu nusakilwe,
Njovwa nzingasile
Coolwe cangu nkukwiziba
Taata ulinfwini.

Kumulimo uuzumine,
Nsusi kubotezya
Kumaciswe, makatazo,
Mbe siswezya-mozo.

Ncite sikwense, sibotu,
Mbe mufune wako
Munsi nje kukala aze,
Sikwense mwanaako.

items.title: Yoko Wako Ngumubomvu (Cila)
verses:
Yoko wako ngumubomvu
Watukatulula myozo,
Luse lwako ngumatilo,
Ndiwe utukobelela.
Kutangala twakuyana,
Koonse nkutuwenzya Mwami
Batulwisya balatiya,
Twabazunda kulindiwe.

Nitubomba ansi ano,
Watuponya calufuno,
Watuzil’ atwaambo twako
Utufwamba kutuyovwa.
Nituwamba abupusi,
Waca ati: “Muli ame”.
Nituwamba akutiya,
Waingula: “Tuli amwe”.

Sikwense ’tusindikile,
Jesu, Mufutuli wesu,
Ansi ano utuvune,
Mane tukasike kwako.
Koko kwako kutamani,
Lyoonse tukatembaule
Aleluya ku-Sinsana
Utunjizya kwa-Jehova.

items.title: Unyenzisye, Mwami Jesu (Cila)
verses:
Unyenzisye, Mwami Jesu,
Ndime usilweendo ansi.
Ul’ ensana, ome ndiina,
Mdilatiya kweenda ice.
Mufutuli, Mufutuli,
Ndiwe pele ootweenzya.

Unsanzisye, Mwami Jesu,
Ndilikwete sibyaabi
Ulansanzya kumatombe,
Mufutuli, Mufituli,
Ndiwe pele ootusanzya.

Ununune, Mwami Jesu,
Ndyaangilwe ocansana,
Ngu-Saatani wakag’ anga
G’ angulula kulinguwe.
Mufutuli, Mufutuli,
Ndiwe pele oondiponya.

items.title: Muluyando Ulwa-Jesu
verses:
Muluyando ulwa-Jesu
Mwendikede lyoonse,
Mbobusena ububotu,
Butanjilwa zibi,
Ndilalongezegwa oyo
Uwakandifwida,
||Uundibamba aluzyalo,
Eno ndabotelwa.||

Nampocili cinti cibi
Icindibukila,
Lyoonse ndisumpulwa nguwe,
Oyo ngwendisyoma,
Ndoluyando mbul’ ijulu
Ulutalesegwa,
||Ndoluzyalo mbuli lwizi
Uluteelekedwe.||

Ulayanda kumuziba?
Ukamutambule,
Langa eno ul’ afwaafwi
Fwaamba ’mutobele!
Uluyando ulwa-Jesu
Ndulwabantu boonse,
||Ndilalumba Mwami sunu
Mbwaakanditambula.||

items.title: Jata Itansyi, Taata
verses:
Jata itansyi, Taata, ndil’ endike,
Ninjumu, yasofwaala nzila yangu,
Jata itansyi, kuti nditayoowi
Nuuba musinze awa, Mwami wangu.

Jata itansyi, ndimwana musyoonto,
Nsikuzi ukusala nzila yangu,
Jata itansyi, amumakatalo,
Kuti ntawidi ansi, Mwami wangu.

Jata itansyi, Taata, ndabotelwa
Ndiyovwegwe itansyi lyako, Mwami,
Jata itansyi ndilajana nguzu
Nandilizi kuteeti ul’ afwaafwi.

Jata itansyi nalwasika lufu,
Ndiyanda kufutulwa Mwami wangu,
Jata itansyi ndisike kumuunzi,
Ndibone busyu bwako, Jesu wangu.

items.title: Syoma Akuswiilila
verses:
Notuya a-Leza, muluyando lwakwe,
Usalazye inzila yesu;
Notwamuswiilila ukala aswebo,
Abasyoma abaswiilila.

Takukwe mukuli, takukwe kupenga
Ulatutambula kabotu;
Takukwe kuyoowa, takukwe kunyema,
Kuti twasyoma twaswiilila.

Muluyando lwakwe, tulakala munsi,
Tulaenda awe munzila;
Naamba tucite, twatumwa tuinke,
Mutayoowi pele ’musyome.

choruses.text:
Muswiilile, takwe ’nzila imbi,
Kukondwa muli-Jesu pele kuswiilila.

items.title: Ndateelela Mufutuli
verses:
Ndateelela Mufutuli,
Wandiita nkacilile,
Ati, ciingano cangu
Nciyumune lyoonse, ’mucilile.

Ndacilila ’Getsemane,
Oko kumapenzi oonse,
Akukunenyigwa koonse,
Aluzyalo lwakwe ’mucilile.

Ndacilila kukuusa,
Oko kukukankaminwa,
Ndacilila do kulufu,
Aluzyalo lwakwe ’mucilile.

Ndafutulwa aluzyalo,
Ndayumigwa ’nguzu zyakwe,
Nkandapegwa bwami bwakwe,
Tandi-siyi-siyi pe, lyoonse.

choruses.text:
Koonse nkwaanditumina,
Koonse nkwaanditumina,
Ukalandisololela,
Aluzyalo lwakwe ’mucilile.

items.title: Koonse Koonse Nkwaya Jesu
verses:
Koonse koonse nkwaya Jesu, ndilainka,
Koonse nkwanditumina ansi ano;
Koonse nkwanfiitila ndilamucilila,
Ndilasyoma Jesu, nsikooyoowa, pe.

Koonse koonse Jesu wandisindikila,
Bamwi bandisiya ulakala ame;
Tondisiyi, Jesu swena kulindime,
Ndilasyoma Jesu, nsikooyoowa pe.

Koonse koonse Jesu uliizi inzila,
Kumasena oonse wandisololela;
Kondisindikila ndileend’ ayebo,
Ndilasyoma Jesu, nsikooyoowa pe.

choruses.text:
Sikwense! Sikwense! Nsikooyoowa pe;
Koonse koonse, Mwami ndilakucilila

items.title: O Lukombo
verses:
O Lukombo, O Lukombo,
Lumbweza mulizyanyika
Akundeta kuli-Leza,
Ndimwaambile nzendiyanda;
Muziindi zyamakatazyo
Kanji ndakakatululwa
Akutajatwa Musunki,
Nkaambo kanduwe, Lukombo.

O Lukombo, O Lukombo,
Kotola inkombo zyangu
Kuli-Leza walusyomo
Uuzi kukazika moyo;
Elyo nkaambo wandilaya
Kuti ndisyome ’Jwi lyakwe,
Ndamuletela zipenzya
Mulinduwe, O Lukombo.

items.title: Ndisololela Jehova
Ndilasyoma Jesu
verses:
Ndilastoma, Jesu,
Ndilasyoma, Jesu,
Awo woonse moyo wangu,
Ndilasyoma, Jesu.

Kooneka, Mwami,
Kooneka, Mwami,
Amumoyo wangu woonse,
Kooneka, Mwami.

Ubalete, Jesu,
Ubalete, Jesu,
Abo boonse bakabweeda,
Ubalete, Jesu.

items.title: Ndakusyoma, Mwami Jesu (Cila)
verses:
Ndakusyoma, Mwami Jesu,
Mdiwena olike
Ulozya kunfutulila
Mafunze.

Nkusyomene nsana, Mwami,
Ndimufwafwalisi,
Tukal’ aze, mbe muzumo
Sikwense.

Nkusyomene ’bo busongo,
Mdime mulimbusi,
Nsindakwiizi nzila yako
Iisweya.

Nkusyomene kusanziwa
Mubulowa bwako,
Kosalazya mozo woonse
Usunu.

items.title: Ngwinzanda Lyoonse (Cila)
verses:
Ngwinzanda lyoonse
Ngu-Mwami uSiluse,
Naakalilila mwangu
Mulatontola ne.

Ngwinzanda lyoonse,
Ngu-Mwami nSinsana,
Uunzundya masukusyo
Jesu uunzumya nta.

Ngwinzanda lyoonse,
Ngu-Mwami owabuumi
Kucoolwe, kumapenzi,
Takasanduki pe.

Ngwinzanda lyoonse,
Ngu-Mwami uukanjiya
Luzando lwa-Taatesu
Iciindi coonse.

choruses.text:
Ngwinzanda ndiwe Jesu,
Tube aze Mwami,
Mpa coolwe cabasyomi,
Ndeziza inzyo.

items.title: Lusyomo Lutakamani
verses:
Lusyomo lutakamani,
Nolukatazigwa;
Lutakayowi mapenzi,
||Nobasinkondoma.||

Lusyomo lutakatongi,
Nalwalaigwa;
Pele mumapenzi alo.
||Lukasyome Leza.||

Lusyomo lukakomene
Kabotu lyoonse;
Kwina kulimbulula
||Amapenzi oonse.||

Leza kotupa lusyomo,
Luzunda lyoonse;
Elyo tuya kumubona,
||Kumuunzi okuya.||

items.title: Ibbwe Liyumu
verses:
Kulangila kwangu koonse
Kuli mubulowa bwakwe;
Ndasyoma Jesu alike
Nguwakandisalulula.

Na mudima wamusisa,
Ndajata luse luyumu;
Nokuba mapenzi abe,
Ndatijila kulinguwe.

Kusyomezya abulowa,
Nkokum’vuna mumasunko
Bamwi nibawa cibi,
Ndiya kukala anguwe.

Akuboola amukunga,
Ndayanda akantambule;
Nkesamide bululami,
Nketakwe kaambo awalo.

items.title: Atusyome Mwami Jesu
items.original: ‘TIS SO SWEET TO TRUST IN JESUS
verses:
Atusyome Mwami Jesu,
Tuteelele majwi aakwe;
Cisyomezyo tucisyome,
Cakapegwa kulindiswe.

Atusyome Mwami Jesu,
Syoma kusalala kwakwe;
Atusambe mubulowa,
Tulasanzya zibi zyesu.

Atusyome Mwami Jesu,
Wanngululwe ’zibi zyesu;
Tukajane buumi bwakwe,
’Kubotelwa akuumuna.

Ndabotelwa kumusyoma,
Jesu, Mufutuli wnagu;
Ndizi kuti al’ amebo,
Sunu akumamanino.

choruses.text:
Jesu, Jesu, twamusyoma,
Twamuyanda eneeno;
Jesu, Jesu, Mwami wesu,
Tumusyome lyoonse.

items.title: Nsius’ Insoni Ukwa-Jesu (Cila)
verses:
Nsius’ insoni ukwa-Jesu
Okuciingano,
Ninsana syaka-Leza wesu.
Mbusibonwa ano.

Ndeziba izina lyakwe,
Jesu uusyomeka,
Tasimbulila nsana syakwe,
Mwami ngundemeka.

Ndeziba Mwami ngwinsyomene,
Inzyo ndilaminwe
Kuti walozya kucibamba
Ncimbikilwe kwakwe.

Kubusyu bwaka-Leza, Jesu
Ukalansimuna,
Ukalandulikila kwakwe
Bukalilo bwangu.

choruses.text:
Kuncico, kuncico,
Ciingano ca-Jesu,
Nkundemunwa syandemena umozo
Kuncico ndibwene lufuno lwakwe,
Cilantangazya lyoonse.

items.title: Ndajana Mweenzuma
verses:
Ndajana mweenzuma mwini,
Owakandiyasilwa;
Wakandipa kufutuka;
Ulwakwe mwini Jesu.
Kunyuna ncenga’mba ncangu,
Nkwe ndijisi nko kwakwe,
Moyo aunguzu zyangu,
Nzizyakwe kutamani.

Ndajana mweenzuma mwini,
Wapegwa nguzu zyoonse,
Zyakundyeenzya munzila,
Ndikasike kujulu,
Coolwe cilamweka munsi,
Cilandibuzya calo,
Eno ndanyona, ndalwana,
Ndilakulyookezya ko.

items.title: Ibbwe Eli Ngu-Mwami Wesu
items.original: A SHELTER IN THE TIME OF STORM
verses:
Ibbwe wli ngu-Mwami wesu,
Tuya kuyubila mumo;
Nakuba kukatazigwa,
Knocili coonde ciyumu.

Ncisitilizyo isikati,
Tuya kuyubila mumo;
Muntu takatuyoosyi,
Nkocili coonde ciyumu.

Mapenzi navula buti,
Tuya kuyubila mumo;
Tulajana muli-Leza,
Nkocili coonde ciyumu.

Citijila eci ndibbwe,
Tuya kuyubila mumo;
Koba nduwe utugwasya,
Nkocili coonde ciyumu.

choruses.text:
Nciyumu coonde canguzu,
Ncimvule ciindi nikupya;
Mwendezi wakeendenda,
Nkocili coonde ciyumu.

items.title: Jesu, Ciingano Cangu (Cila)
verses:
Jesu, ciingano cangu,
Ndacibweza, nkucilile,
Mbe mupusi, musampule,
Ndi muvubi mulindiwe.
Syabulyo syaswewa,
Syaninzyo syalekwa,
Pele ome ndisicoolwe,
Ninfuila syezeulu.

’Ba-Saatani bansampaula,
Bakamusampaula Jesu
Mbundasyoma nibancenga,
Mwami Mwini wasyomeka.
Nuucimwenamwena,
Kwina ucimpenzya
Nabansiya, nabansula,
Ncisakilwe mulindiwe.

Mozo wangu utambule
Lufutuko luzulile
Makatazyo na matizyo,
Alazundwa mulinguwe.
Bweza ciingano
Cakwe cabulemu,
Mwami Mwini ngu-Sinsana,
Utusisya kubumane.

items.title: Komusyoma
verses:
Koboola umwi azingwa
Kuluse lwa-Leza;
Uyoojana luumuno,
Akusyoma Ijwi.

Bulowa bwakatilwa ansi,
Nkwa-Jesu Muvuni;
Dumpukila mubulowa
Samba utube bu.

Jesu ninzila mbo buumi
Ujane luumuno;
Komusyoma sunu buya,
Ulatondezegwa.

Njila lumamba lusweya,
Ukaye kujulu;
Tukanjile muunzi mupya,
Kutangala lyoonse.

choruses.text:
Komusyoma, komusyoma,
Kosyoma lino;
Ulavuna, ulavuna,
Uvuna lino.

items.title: Ndilakondwa
verses:
Ndilakondwa nkaambo Leza wesu,
Waamba luyando lwakwe mwiBbuku;
Muzigambya zili mu-Malembe.
Cipati ncakuti wandiyanda.

Wandiyanda, ame ndamuyanda,
Nduyando lwakamuleta kunsi;
Nduyando lwamucita amfwide,
Mdasinizya kuti wandiyanda.

Ndabuzigwa inga ndilaambanzi?
Majwi ngenkonzya kuvuwa ngaaya;
Muuya wa-Leza ulaandyambila
Kuti Jesu lyoonse wandiyanda.

choruses.text:
Ndakondwa kuti wandiyanda,
Wandiyanda, wandiyanda;
Ndakondwa kuti wandiyanda,
Wandiyanda, mebo.

items.title: Mumulimo wa-Mwami
items.original: IN THE SERVICE OF THE KING
verses:
Ndabotelwa, mumulimo wa-Mwami,
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa;
Ndilijisi kutangala kwa-Leza,
Mumulimo wa-Mwami.

Ndabotelwa mumulimo wa-Mwami,
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa;
Na kuumuna na mapenzi ndaimba,
Mumulimo wa-Mwami.

Ndabotelwa mumulimo wa-Mwami,
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa;
Ndajatilila itansi lyakwe,
Mumulimo wa-Mwami.

Ndabotelwa, mumulimo wa-Mwami,
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa;
Zintu zyangu ndazipa kulinduwe,
Mumulimo wa-Mwami.

choruses.text:
Mumulimo wa-Mwami,
Matalenta ndaleta,
Ndilijisi cilongezyo,
Mumulimo wa-Mwami.

items.title: Ndayanda Kwaamba Kaambo
items.original: I LOVE TO TELL THE STORY
verses:
Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo
Kazitalibonya,
Jesu acoolwe cakwe,
Aluyando lwakwe;
Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo,
Mbwendizi kasimpe,
Kalandikomanisya
Kuli zintu zyoonse.

Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo,
Kalainda koonse
Nkotuyanda kuyeeya
Mukulota kwesu;
Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo,
Akakandivuna,
Ncendiimba kaambo aka
Kulinduwe eno.

Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo
Nkainu, kukamba
Lyoonse nindakanana,
Kainda kubota;
Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo,
Bamwi batanamvwa,
Kaambo kakufutuka
MwiBbuku lya-Leza.

choruses.text:
Ndayanda kwaamba kaambo,
Kalaba coolwe cangu,
Kwaamba kaambo kakale
Kaluyando lwakwe.

items.title: Naulabotelwa
verses:
Naulabotelwa
Lumba, lumba,
Ombuli muyuni
Ulaimba;
Nawatumwa Muuya,
Fwamba utuulele,
Fwamba ukombelwe,
Tumwiimbile.

Nawabona Jesu
Lumba, lumba,
Lumba luse lwakwe,
Tumwiimbile;
Wakatupengela,
Wakatubukila,
Uwakatufwida,
Tumwiimbile.

Naul’ amapenzi
Lumba, lumba,
Kulamubotezya,
Tumwiimbile;
Boonse abaangelo
Balalumba Mwami,
Lumba, lumba abo,
Tumwiimbile.

choruses.text:
Atumwiimbile,
Kulamubotezya;
Atutangalisye,
Tumwiimbile.

items.title: Moyo Ulumba Jehova
verses:
Moyo ulumba Jehova,
Moyo utaangwi;
Moyo ubona bulowa,
||Bwatililwa ndime.||

Moyo mutete, O-Mwami,
Cuuno ca-Muvuni
Nkwatelelwa Mwami Kristo,
||Nkwakala alike.||

Moyo mubombe, mutete,
Usyoma, usweya;
Kwina cintu caandanya,
||Mwami ambebo.||

Moyo uyeezya zibotu,
Amulusinizyo,
Moyo ululeme mbuli
||Moyo yako, Mwami.||

items.title: Mumapenzi Oonse Ngojana
verses:
Mumapenzi ayo oonse ngojana,
Mukuusa koonse amukweetela;
Bala zilongezyo Leza nzyakupa,
Mbube ualumba nkaambo zyavula.

Walemenwa akupenga yoomwana,
Iciingano ncoyumwine calema?
Bala buyo zintu Leza nzyakupa,
’Lwiimbo kumulumba ulalujana.

Na wabona ubuvubi bwabantu,
Utazilingi zyoonse zilamana;
Bala buyo zilongezyo nzyakupa,
Kujulu uyookupa buumi bwako.

Eno mumapenzi oonse utacimwi,
Leza u-Mupati ulakubona;
Walo nguuzi nzila yoonse njoenda,
’Lweendo loonse mwini ulakugwasya.

choruses.text:
Bandauka zintu zibotu,
Bandauka nzyakupa Leza;
Kozibala uzibandauke,
Mbube ulalumba nkaambo zyavula.

items.title: Jesu Mufutuli Wangu
verses:
Jesu Mufutuli wangu,
Mufutuli uyandwa;
Ndamufugamina buti
Nkaambo kaluse lwakwe;
Kwasiya mbi loko.
Walangaula ’mbelele,
Wakanfileta kumuunzi.

Jesu Munununi wangu
Eno ndamuyandisya;
Jesu ndebbwe lyangu
Alufutuko lwangu;
Kusekelela kwa-Mwami,
Nkukwangu lyoonse.
Kwina bukata mu-Jesu
Wapona kulindime.

choruses.text:
Jesu, Jesu, wainda bantu boonse,
Jesu, Jesu, ndilaba mwanaako;
Koonse kondisololela,
Ndilacilila ko,
Elyo musinzo wamana,
Ndabona busyu bwako.

items.title: Jesu, Ndilakuyanda
verses:
Jesu, ndilakuyanda, ndizi uli wangu,
Ndazisiya zibi eziyanza zyaansi,
Muvuni waboonse, Mufutuli wangu,
Ii, ndakuyanda, kukabe kutamani.

Ndakuyanda ukuti ucindiyandisya,
Wakandinununa muzibi zipati,
Wasama musini wamamvwa ankumo,
Ii, ndakuyanda, kukabe kutamani.

Ndakuyanda nendiwe, nokuba nandafwa,
Njoolumba nencili mucisi omuno,
Ndiyooti kukufwa kwamubili wangu,
Ii, ndakuyanda, kukabe kutamani.

Akumaanda aa-Mwami nkoku-Mufutuli,
Ndiyookala lyoonse mumuunzi wejulu,
Njooimba amusini amutwe wangu,
Ii, ndakuyanda, kukabe kutamani.

items.title: Lumba! Lumba!

choruses.text:
Lumba, lumba,
Amba luzyalo lwakwe;
Lumba, lumba,
Lyoonse mulwiimbo.

items.title: Jesu Nguwangu
verses:
Kwina buusu, Jesu nguwangu
Kulabila bubotu bwa-Leza;
Makani akwe, muulo wakwe,
Musalwi ’Muuya, ndasanzigwa.

Lusyomo lwangu, Jesu nguwangu!
Jesu ngu-Musololi wangu;
Baangelo bakwe balaboola,
Baangelo bakwe balaboola,
Mazuba oonse kundiyovwa.

Lusyomo lwangu, Jesu nguwangu!
Kuzuminisya, kulyookezya;
Mu-Mufutuli ndalelekwa,
Ndaangululwa, ndime wakwe.

choruses.text:
Makani angu, Jesu nguwangu!
Ndalumba Mwani ciindi coonse.
Makani angu, Jesu nguwangu!
Ndalumba Mwano ciindi coonse.

items.title: Ndamulumba
verses:
Nindakuubona mwinzo
Uli bukwazi lyoonse;
Ndamvwa kusela kwa-Muuya,
Wandiita, “Kosamba”.

Nikuba kuti inzila,
Yalulama, yasweya;
Ndazumina kuli Leza
Kuleka zibi zyangu.

Elyo Muuya Usweyisya
Wanjila mumoyo wangu;
Nsikalubi kumulumba,
Aleluya ku-Mwami.

Walelekwa Jesu Kristo,
Ndabotelwa lyoonse;
Zibi zyangu zyajatilwa,
Moyo wangu wasamba.

choruses.text:
Ndamulumba, ndamulumba,
Mwami uwakatufwida;
Tumupe bulemu boonse,
Bulowa bwakwe bwatusanzya.

items.title: Jesu Ul’ Ame Ciindi Coonse
verses:
Jesu ul’ ame ciindi coonse,
Ndilamusyoma, Mwami wangu,
Ndilayeeya Jesu Mwini
Ng’wakandifwid’ a-Kalvari.

Ndalumbaizya Mufutuli,
Wakandiyanda cinicini,
Wakazumina kulipeda,
Wakandifwid’ a-Kalvari.

Ndilabotelwa kutobela
Moonse munzila mwanditola.
Ndilateelela majwi aakwe
Mbwaakandifwid’ a-Kalvari.

Nsilimbululi, nsikooyoowa,
Nkaambo ndasyoma Mwami Jesu
Bumwi buzuba ndiyoobona
Uwandifwid’ a-Kalvari.

choruses.text:
Jesu ul’ame ciindi coonse,
Jesu ul’ ame ’lweendo loonse,
Ngo-Mulongwaangu uutandisiyi,
Nkaambo ndayeeya Kalvari.

items.title: Afwaafwi, Afwaafwi
verses:
Jesu ngo-Muvuni wangu,
Wainda zintu zyoonse;
Munzila yangi yoonse,
Kuti nkende ayebo.
||Afwaafwi, afwaafwi,||
Munzila yangu yoonse,
Kuti nkende ayebo.

Nsikombeli impuwo,
Nuuba mulimo muuba,
Njakukupengela Mwami,
Kuti nkende ayebo.
||Afwaafwi, afwaafwi,||
Njakukupengela Mwami,
Kuti nkende ayebo.

Sololela buumi bwangu
Mubusena bwalufu
Mulyango ’takoojalwa,
Kuti njile ayebo.
||Afwaafwi, afwaafwi,||
Mulyango ’takoojalwa,
Kuti njile ayebo.

items.title: Taata, Ukandipe Moyo
verses:
Taata, ukandipe moyo
Usalala buya;
Ukandipe muuya mupya
Ul’ akusinizya.

Ulawuyandisya moyo
Uli akuusa;
Tokoowusula umuuya
Uwakulibonzya.

Taata, utakandisowi
Kubooneki bwako,
Kwalo ukandibotezya
’Kubotelwa kwako.

Kosinkula matwi angu
’Mvwe luzyalo lwako;
Nkembaambila ababisya,
Amakani aako.

items.title: Wakamba Na?
verses:
Koocili mug’ anda yako.
Sa wakomba na?
Mwizina lya-Mwami Jesu,
Mbuli intobo?

Nuwasukusigwa sunu,
Sa wakomba na?
Mukulemekezya kwakwe,
Sa wabuzya muuya wakwe,
Kukuzolweda?

Na wanyemo moyo wako,
Sa wakomba na?
Sa wabuzya luse, Musa,
Kuti ujatile umwi,
Wakubisizya?

Mapenzi acis’ askika,
Sa wakomba na?
Na moyo wako wausa,
Sena wakumbila ’nguzu, Nobwaca sunu?

choruses.text:
Kukomba kugwasya bantu,
Kukomba kusandula,
Mudima kuba mumuni,
Kokomba sunu.

items.title: Utakundiinda
verses:
Ndakomba utakundiinda,
Muvuni wangu;
Abamwi wabaswiilila,
Nswiilila ambe.

Isunu ndilazwa moyo,
Ndaleka eno;
Abamwi wabausila,
Usila ambe.

Takwe umbi undigwasya,
Ndiwe olike;
Abamwi wabasilika
Nsilika ambe.

Nsikwe zilakubotezya,
Ndili mupusi;
Abamwi tokoobatanda,
Tontandi ambe.

choruses.text:
Jesu, Jesu, ndakukumbila,
Abamwi wakubagwasya
Tondiindi ambe.

items.title: Jesu, Mwami, Kondiyovwa
verses:
Jesu, Mwami, kondiyovwa,
Ukuzunda zintu zyoonse
Nsizi zintu ziti sike,
Lufu nalusika lili,
Kwalo Jesu ulizizi,
Jesu, Mwami, kondiyovwa.

Mbwendakala ansi ano,
Ulakonzya kundilela.
Zintu zyoonse zyateelela
Jes, Mwami, Mufutuli,
Ulakonzya kundiyovwa.

Nakwasika kufwa kwangu,
Ndipa icibanda cako,
Ndipa ukuyanda kwako,
Inteelele majwi aako,
Alaamba kulindime:
“Ndakuyovwa! Utayoowi.”

items.title: Ndilamwaambila Jesu

choruses.text:
Ndilamwaambila! Ndilamwaambila!
Nsikonzyi kuyumuna mukuli;
Ndilamwaambila Jesu alike,
Ulandigwasya, Jesu wangu.

items.title: Ninsene Kwako, Leza (Cila)
verses:
Ninsene kwako, Leza,
Nsene kwako,
Nikuba kumapenzi,
Nsenye ako.
Ndulolu lwiimbo lwangu,
Mizeezo iili kwangu,
Ninsene kwako
Nsene kwako.

Ninsene kwako, Leza,
Nsene kwako,
Nciceeci ncimbulila,
Manga ako.
Nkukuti nkasenyiwe
Kufwaafwi kulindiwe,
Ninsene kwako
Nsene kwako.

Ninsene kwako, Leza,
Unsenyisye,
Nciceeci ncinkumbila,
Tukayanane aze,
Tukafunane aze,
Ninsene kwako
Nsene kwako.

items.title: Ndili Wako, Mwami
verses:
Ndili wako, Mwami, ndilimvwide ijwi
Ilyamba aluyando,
Kwalo moyo wangu ulayandisiya
Ukuswena kulinduwe.

Konditola, Mwami, nkabe wako ’like,
Ndalitula buya sunu;
’Moyo wangu woonse amatansyi angu,
Nkumanine imilimo.

Kulandibotezya kufugama, Mwami,
Nkotilongezegwa nduwe,
Nkotujana nguzu aluzundo loonse,
Nkotwaambaul’ ayebo.

Uluyando lwako ndolupati, Mwami,
Tatukonzya kulweeleka;
Kubotelwa oku nkotujisi kuno,
Kulayungililwa kuya.

choruses.text:
Kondiswenya, kondiswenya, Mwami,
Kuciingan cako;
Kondisweny’ afwaafwi, kondiswenya, Mwami,
Kuciinfano cako.

items.title: Ciindi Cakukomba
verses:
Ciindi cakumupaila,
Cilatondezya mulimo,
Cilandiita kuya kwakwe,
Kwaambilwa nko ndiyandisya,
Muziindi zyakupengesya,
Lyoonse ndajana kuvunwa,
Kuzwa kukubisya kwangu,
Muciinci cakumukomba.

Ciindi cakumupaila,
Ndamvwa kukondwa ’luzyalo,
Ula babo balindila,
Kuboola kwa-Mwami Jesu,
Ndafwambaana kucilao,
Kubona busyu bwa-Leza,
Kutambula cuuno cangu,
Akulindila kumukomba.

Ciindi cakumupaila,
Mababa alakutola,
Kuli oyo usyomeka,
Kukukondezya yebo,
Ulandiita kumuyanda,
Akuzumina ’kusyoma,
Ndilainka julinguwe,
Kulindila kumukomba.

items.title: Ciingano Cajulwa
verses:
Ciingano cajulwa,
Ndisise mulincico;
Zumizya bulowa bwako,
Bwakunka kulinduwe,
Bube bwakusilisya
Zibi, Lunungu loonse.

Ndalila kutamani,
Busungu butamani,
Tabulungili zibi;
Nduwe mwini olike,
Ofutula babisyi,
Pele bulowa bwako.

Kulamana juyoya
Meso angu aona,
Moyo wangu waunka,
Kucuuno ca-Mwami;
Ciingano cajulwa,
Ndisise mulincico.

items.title: Ndayandisya Mumalundu
verses:
Ndayandisya mumalundu,
Ndatanta mazuba oonse;
Ndaya kukomba koonse
Leza ndikwela kujulu.

Nsiyandi kukala ano,
Atakondwi akuyowa,
Banji balayand’ okuno,
Mebo ndayanda kujulu.

Ndayanda kuteelelesya,
Na Saatani ulapenzya;
Mbondakondwa kuli-Leza
Mdilakwiinka kujulu.

choruses.text:
Leza ndibweza, ndiime,
Mukukondwa kwakujulu;
Cilao cilamfu eco,
Leza, ndikwela kujulu.

items.title: Jesu, Owamasi-masi (Cila)
verses:
Jesu owamasi-masi,
Uufutula boonse,
Mukuzingasila banji,
Nzingasila Jesu
||Nzingasila,||
Nzingasila Jesu.

Jesu owangwala bako
MwiBbuku lyako,
Mukoompolola banji,
Ngompolola Jesu
||Ngompolola,||
Mgompolola Jesu.

Jesu oweenzya bako
Kwizeulu kwako,
Ame nkeenzyiwe ndiwe,
Ndeezye nzila, Jesu
||Ndeezye znila,||
Ndeezye nzila, Jesu.

Jesu owanjizya bako
Momo mwizeulu,
Utandubi, ndimwanaako,
Undinjinzye Jesu.
||Undunjizye,||
Undinjizye Jesu.

items.title: Amajwi Oonse aa-Mwami Leza
verses:
Amajwe oonse aa-Mwami Leza
Mabotu nkaambo ngaakwe Mwini,
Azibwe ansi akujulu,
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!

Kwakafwa oonse malangalanga,
Kwavumbwa zuba amakumbi,
Zibotu zilafwamba kwiinda
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!

Balafwa bantu abatamwizi,
Balila, balemenwa zibi
Katuya tubakombelele,
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!

Ubuumi tuyoobujana kwakwe,
Bukalo bwesu bwakujulu,
Lyoonse tuyooimba oko,
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!

choruses.text:
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!
Owandiyanda Nkentanaziba
Tola majwi aa-Jesu!

items.title: Kobeleka
verses:
Kobeleka! Kobeleka! Tobazike ba-Leza,
Atutobele ’nguzu zya-Mwami wesu;
Ulatupa inguzu zyakubeleka,
Atucite enguzu mulimo wa-Leza.

Kobeleka! Kobeleka! Sanina bafwa nzala,
Kobasolweda batete kufutuka;
Nce ciingano catupa coolwe cesu,
Tulaimba “Lufutuko lwabantu boonse”

Kobeleka! Kobeleka! Munguzu zya-Mwami,
Tulakulyookezya kuzwa mumulimo;
Kumuunzi wa-Jehova, tulakala oko,
Tulaimba “Lufutuko lwabantu boonse.”

choruses.text:
Beleka, beleka,
Beleka, beleka;
’Tusyome, ’tulange,
Mane Jesu akaboole.

items.title: Amuboole Nomuyanda Mwami
items.original: COME, YE THAT LOVE THE LORD
verses:
Kamuza muswiilile majwi aa-Leza
Twiimbe lwiimbo lubotu,
Twiimbe lwiimbo lubotu
Kucuuno ca-Leza, kucuuno ca-Leza.

Batakondwi tabazyi kulumbaizya Leza,
Baya kupengesya lyoonse,
Baya kupengesya lyoonse,
Tabaizi nzla iya ku-Zioni.

Mulundu wa-Zioni uzyala zibotu
Tatunasika kujulu,
Tatunasika kujulu,
Tatuna kweenda munzila yagolida.

Twiimbe nyimbo zibotu misozi ’sansamuke
Tuya kuli-Leza wesu,
Tuya kuli-Leza wesu,
Kunyika imbotu, kunyika imbotu.

choruses.text:
Twittigwa toonse, atufwambaane bakwesu,
Tuli mulwendo ku-Zioni, kumuunzi wa-Leza.

items.title: Futula Basweeki
verses:
Futula, futula mbo bazimide,
Boonse basweekede bayoopenga;
Bafwide luzyalo kobalilila,
Bantunyoko basweeka, basweeka.

Ambila, ambila makani oonse,
Kobaambila inzila imbotu;
Koompolola bakambauka,
Kuti Jesu akabafutule.

Kombela, kombela bantu bapenzi,
Leza ulakumvwa akugwasye;
Jesu Siluyando ulabaponya,
Ulabagwasya akufutuka.

Myoyo yabeenzuma ilafwa nzala,
Ilalindila luse lwa-Jesu;
Luyando lul’ enguzu zyakukwela,
Lulasandula moyo wamuntu.

choruses.text:
Futula, futula bantu basweeka,
Bantunyoko basweeka sunu.

items.title: Kuyandaula Basweekede
verses:
Tulayandaula abasweekede,
Baingaila mumalundu;
Tulababula majwi aa-Mwami,
“Amuboole kulime nywebo.”

Tulayandaula abasweekede
Twatondezya babisyi Jesu,
Tulabeenzya munzila ya-Mwami,
Yakufutuka kutamani.

Ndilayanda kucilila Jesu,
Kwengelela abaciswa,
Ndayanda kwimisya abawa,
Kuleta basweekede kwakwe.

choruses.text:
Kule, kule, mumalundu malamfu
Tulaleta, basweekede,
Muluba, muluba lwa-Mwami Jesu
Mwana ’mbelele owakayaswa.

items.title: Bantu Boona Umusinze (Cila)
verses:
Bantu boona umusinze,
Bubi obusiya mbi,
Bantu mbanununa Jesu,
Mbatulila buumi
Mazwi manji, lyoonse koonse,
Akwilil’ a-Mwami.

Mwiiyi kwina uubabula
Luse lukwazeme
Muulo mwiinu ngubaulwa,
Meya omisozi
Nombaiye, nombaenzye
Kwakwe Mufutuli.

Ngusicili syabutongo,
Bwamu obulozi,
Bundya, bowa obutavu,
Bufwi obuzike
Nasiziwe, nasizaye!
Ndizwi olya-Mwami.

Atufwambe kubwibusya
Bwanga bwa-Muvuni
Kutabonwi namusweesi
Ngutukausila
Kolya kwakwe, Mubetesi,
Nkutukasakilwa.

items.title: Leta Maila
verses:
Kosyanga cifumo ’mbuto yaluzyalo,
Syanga isikati akumazuba;
Lindila ciindi cakutebula loko,
Akuseka, tuyooleta maila.

Syanga musalala, syanga mumudima,
Utayoowi mayoba na impeyo;
Twamana milimo, yoonse yamumuunda,
Akuseka, tuyooleta maila.

Mukulila ukamusyangile, Mwami,
Antela moyo ulakupengesya;
Twamana milimo, yoonse uzootutambula,
Akuseka, tuyooleta maila.

choruses.text:
Leta maila, leta maila,
Akuseka, tuyooleta maila;
Leta maila, leta maila,
Akuseka, tuyooleta maila.

items.title: Koyandaula, Taata Leza
verses:
Koyandaula, Taata Leza,
Boonse abakakuloboka;
Saatani mwini wabacenga,
Busongo boonse wabanyanga.

Koyandaula, Mwami Jesu,
Abatajisi Mwami wabo;
Ukabamunikile nzila,
Babnoe umumuni wako.

Usunu bali mumusinze,
Ukutasiki kusalala;
Kwalo kuzywide imisozi,
Kuti baangwa umapenzi.

Leza pilusya bana bako,
Jesu nguwabafwida nsoni;
Ukuti balaliubula,
Bati, “Usunu twazumina”.

Seluka, Muuya Usweyisya,
Ukasweyisye buumi bwesu;
Tambula imibili yesu,
Ezintu zyoonse nzotujisi.

Sinkula matwi eesu toonse,
Makani ako akayake;
Nzotwaambilwa sunu, Mwami,
Ziyume mumyoyo yesu.

items.title: Mulwane, Ndaboola
verses:
Nobayandwa amulange,
Tuyoogwasigwa;
Basinkondo balaboola,
Tuya kuzunda.

Mulange basinkondoma
Kabaciboola;
Bapati bamwi balawa
Nkaambo twatyompwa.

Eno mubone ndembela,
Amumvwe mpeta!
Mwizina lya-Mufutuli
Tuya kukomba.

Nakuba kulwa nkuyumu
Tulagwasigwa;
Mwami wesu ulandiswe,
Ulatuyumya.

choruses.text:
“Mulwane, ndaboola eno!”
Amumvwe Jesu;
Muleelede kumwiingula,
“Twacita boobo.”

items.title: Ndice’nda Mumusinzo
verses:
Munzi wangu mupya nkuli?
Ndice’nda mumusinzo;
Kwina mapenzi okuya,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo.

Tuya kubona Muvuni,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo;
Kwina misozi okuya,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo.

Bamwi bayandisya ansi,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo;
Kucita zintu zibiabi
Ndice’nda mumusinzo.

Leza wandipa inguzu,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo;
Limwi nkabone kujulu,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo.

choruses.text:
Ii nce’nda mumusinzo,
Ndice’nda mumusinzo;
Munzi wangu mupya nkuli?
Ndice’nda mumusinzo.

items.title: Kunyonena Busiku Buleza
items.original: WORK, FOR THE NIGHT IS COMING
verses:
Fwambaana kunyonena busiku buleza,
Izuba litanazwa, fuma, nyonena;
Alimwi asikati, nikucikasaala,
Nyonena utaleki tulakotoka.

Muna-Kristo, nyona busiku buleza
Lyaunka kale zuba ukalyookezya
Nyona amangolezya, kutanasiya mbi;
Eno milimo yoonse yamaninina.

items.title: Njandoobona Jesu Mwami
verses:
Njandoobona Jesu Mwami,
Njandoobona Mufutuli,
Nsikooba amuntu omwe
Ngwendaleta kulinguwe.

Nsikooyoowa lufu mebo,
Nkaamba ndafutulwa kale,
Pele ndali kulengaala
Ciindi cakukambauka.

Ndakasowa ciindi cangu
Kuno ndali umutolo,
Ino ndiyooima buti
Oko kuli Mwami wangu?

Amubuke no-BaKristo,
Amusungilizye bamwi,
Nolutanasika lufu,
Lukajane basanduka.

choruses.text:
Ino ndiinke buti kuya
Nkentajisi bamwi bantu?
Ndiyoousa cinicini
Nkaambo ndali kulengaala.

items.title: Nombungano Yakwe
verses:
’Lange, nombungano, Ilakuzyangama
Impi ya-Saantani Ilayoowa Jesu.
Kautelelesya, Majwi alazunda,
Kulemeka Jesu Mwami Ngo-Muzundi wesu.

Bami boonse baansi Bazoomana boonse
Kwalo imbungano Ilakala lyoonse.
Impi ya-Saatani Tiikooyoozunda,
Wati Jesu, Mwini lwakwe, Liime Ijwi lyakwe.

Kamutanda impi, Muswaangane nyoonse
Muzundile Jesu, Majwi alazunda,
Kamubanda Jesu Leza, Mwami wesu
Alemekwe ciindi coonse, Jesu ulasweya.

choruses.text:
Tembaula Leza,
Lemya Mufutuli;
Nkwali Mufutuli,
Tulamucilila.

items.title: Ndijisi Kubamba
items.original: A CHARGE TO KEEP I HAVE
verses:
Ndeelede kubamba,
Makani amoyo;
Muuya utakwe kumana,
Ubambilwa ’julu.

Kukwelela Leza,
Boonse basweekede;
Tambula inguzu zyangu
Kusumpula Jesu.

Kondipa bulondo
Nkapone lyoonse;
Nkabambe buumi bubotu,
Kupa kulinguwe.

Ndiyovwa nkalinde,
Nkasyome Muvuni;
Kuti ndamutama Mwami,
Njakufwa lyoonse.

items.title: Muzyime Nubakwesu (Cila)
verses:
Muzyime nubakwesu,
Basimpi baka-Jesu,
Amukasame syoonse
Sya-Leza osyakulwa
Nguwena Mwami Jesu
Uukatusololela Kubasinkondonina,
Boonse mbutukazunda.

Lusyomo mulubweze
Ibe intobo yenu,
Musame lufutuko
Buli nkuani yenu
Iceba lyakulwisya
Ngu-Moza ngumwapewa,
Inguwe umulwisya Myozo yabutongo.

Insana situzumya
Nsya-Jesu walolona,
Mwasyoma nsana syenu,
Noonse mukalazundwa
Amumukakatile,
Mulwisye bsinkondo,
Boonse bakalazaya Kwa-Leza Mwami wesu.

Muzyime nubakwesu,
Inkondo nkwiili sunu,
Uzona muteelele
Inyimbo syabazunndi
Uuzunda ulayana
Busena ukwa-Leza,
Takakapoli koko, Wakala ko sikwense.

items.title: Yebo, Moyo Wangu
items.original: MY SOUL, BE ON THY GUARD
verses:
Yebo, moyo wangu,
Konga kosongwaala;
Mpobali mbomulwan’ abo,
Abakubukila.

Kolinda ukombe,
Utaleki nkondo;
Iciindi coonse kumbila
Inguzu zya-Mwami.

Utayeeyi sunu
Kusowa masumo;
Mulimo oyu tuumani
Notucikal’ ansi.

Sungwaala, Omoyo,
Mane aku lufu;
Leza uyookutambula
Mumuunzi okuya.

items.title: Ngu-Jesu Wakaamba
verses:
Ngu-Jesu wakaamba
Kubasikwiiya bakwe
Naakayanda kubweeda
Kumuunzi wakujulu,
“Kamuya mubaiisye
Ezina eli lyangu,
Bamasi mubazibye
Makani oonse angu.

“Kamuya moompolole
El’ Ivangeli lyangu,
Mubaiisye abantu
Milazyo yangu yoonse.
Ukuti uundisyoma,
Uyooba uufutulwa
Ukuti uundikaka
Uyoob’ uufwidilila.

“Muye enguzu zyangu,
Zyapegwa ndime zyoonse,
Mulange njooba ’nywebo
Mane kumamanino.”
Amane ukwaamba
Wasumpulwa mujulu
Mbube baya kumasi
Bakambauka Ijwi.

items.title: Tuli Kubusyu Bwako
verses:
Tuli kubusyu bwako,
Taata, Mwami wesu,
Tupe luzyalo lwako
Mukukomba kwesu
Tumvwide ukulila
Kwambo basweekede,
Tulabakumbilila, Mwami, abapone.

Amasi manjimanji
Ali mukusiya,
Ali munzila imbi
Iya kumapenzi
Uwafwide uluzyalo,
’Ape Ijwi lyako,
Uwagwisye mukusiya Akusweya kwako.

Kotmua bafundisi
Bal’ enguzu zyako,
Baambile bantu boonse
Amakani ako
Booneki bwako buze
Ansi oonse, Mwami,
Kovuzya bantu bako Akumasi oonse.

Taata, kofwambya ciindi
Icibotu cako,
Awo abanut boonse
Babe Ejwi lyako
Bamuzibe Jehova,
Umubumbi wabo,
Bamuyande Jesu Kristo, Mufutuli wabo.

items.title: Naakatusiya (Cila)
verses:
Naakatusiya,
Jesu, Mwami wesu,
Wakatusiila mulazyo,
Tumuzingasile.

Situzibalusya
Nsitubona sunu
Ndoluseba ndutupewa,
Obulowa bwakwe.

Tukalube buti
Lufuno lwa-Jesu?
Kwina lunji lulukozya,
Twalwezwa kundulo.

Tukalube buti,
Mufutuli wesu,
Owakeziz’ ansi ano,
Akatupe buumi?

Twamuzingasila,
Twamuzeeza sunu,
Ngu-Siluse, ngu-Simanga,
Jesu, Mwami wesu.

items.title: Nendalange Kuciingano
items.original: WHEN I SURVEY THE WONDROUS CROSS
verses:
Nendalanga kuciingano
Akafwida Mwini Bwami
Ndaamba nsijisi cintu,
Ndabuseka bwami, bwangu.

Langa mutwe amaboko,
Abulowa aluyando
Sena wabona luyando,
Akupenga kuli boobo?

Ndakali kusweekede,
Ndakanununwa bulowa;
Andileke kulilemya,
Pele muciingano cakwe.

Nendajisi nyika yoonse,
Nci cilumbulo cisyoonto
Luyando oluli boobo,
Lulaita moyo wangu.

items.title: Kala Aswe, Mwami Wesu
verses:
Kala awe, Mwami wesu,
’Tupe uluzyalo lwako;
Tatukwe kupona swebo,
||Tulayanda luse lwako.||

Kala aswe, ’Zuba lyesu,
Utumunikile swebo;
„Tumvwe coonse cisyomezyo,
||’Citambule, tucijate.||

Kala aswe, Mubetesi,
Zunda basinkondonyoko;
Kotukobelela lyoonse,
||Yebo ul’ intobo yesu.||

Kala aswe, Omuvuni,
Ejwi ilibotu lyako.
Kotuyumya, tutatyeli
||Yalo imilao yako.||

Kala aswe, Mufutuli,
’Tucitile lufutuko.
Yovwa, tatunazibila
||Ukukala ukubotu.||

Kala aswe, Leza wesu,
Atubambwe luse lwako,
Kuti mumapenzi eesu,
||Mwami, utubambisisye.||

items.title: Fwamba Uzumine
verses:
Fwamba uzumine kukondwa,
Fwamba umuzumine Jesu;
Umwi inga wati, “Kondileka Muuya,
Njakwiita buzuba bweelede.”

items.title: Na Izibi Zyenu Zyasiya
items.original: THOUGH YOUR SINS BE AS SCARLET
verses:
Na izibi zyenu zyasiya,
Zyoonse zilatuba bu;
Na izibi zyenu zyasiya,
Zyoonse zilatuba bu.
Na zisiya buya,
Zilasweya swe!
Na izibi zyenu zyasiya,
Na izibi zyenu zyasiya;
Zyoonse zilatuba bu,
Zyoonse zilatuba bu.

Muzumine nomul’ ezibi,
Amuboole kwa-Leza;
Muzumine nomul’ ezibi,
Amuboole kwa-Leza.
Ul’ aluzyalo lupati,
Amuyumye-nta!
Muzumine nomul’ ezibi,
Muzumine nomul’ ezibi;
Amuboole kwa-Leza,
Amuboole kwa-Leza.

items.title: Ngooyu Jesu
verses:
Ngooyu Jesu, ngooyu Jesu, Boola kwakwe eno,
Eno boola kwakwe, boola kwakwe eno.

Usilikwe, usilikwe, Usilikwe eno,
Eno usilikwe, usilikwe eno.

Akuponye, akuponye, Akuponye eno,
Eno akuponye, akuponye eno.

Uzumine, uzumine, Uzumine eno,
Eno uzumine, uzumine eno.

Kokumbila, kokumbila, Kokumbila eno.
Eno kokumbila, kokumbila eno.

Ateelele, ateelele, Ateelele eno,
Eno ateelele, ateelele eno.

Ul’ enguzu, ul’ enguzu, Ul’ enguzu eno,
Eno ul’ enguzu, ul’ enguzu eno.

Akusanzye, akusanzye, Akusanzye eno,
Eno akusanzye, akusanzye eno.

Syoma nguwe, syoma nguwe, Syoma nguwe eno,
Eno syoma nguwe, syoma nguwe eno.

items.title: Ndilaboola Eneeno
verses:
Uundiita ngooyu Jesu,
Uundiita ngooyu Jesu, Uundiita ngooyu Jesu,
Ndilaboola, boola eneeno.

Muuya wakwe wandikwela,
Muuya wakwe wandikwela, Muuya wakwe
wandikwela,
Ndilaboola, boola eneeno.

Akukomba ndilakomba,
Akukomba ndilakomba, Akukomba ndilakomba,
Ndilaboola, boola eneeno.

Kuzumina ndazumina,
Kuzumina ndazumina, Kuzumina ndazumina,
Ndilabool, boola eneeno.

Kozisanzya zibi zyangu,
Kozisanzya zibi zyangu, Kozisanzya zibi zyangu,
Ndilabool, boola eneeno.

Mwami Jesu, ndijatila,
Mwami Jesu, ndijatila, Mwami Jesu, ndijatila,
Ndilaboola, boola eneeno.

Akusyoma ndilasyoma,
Akusyoma ndilasyoma, Akusyoma ndilasyoma,
Ndilaboola, bool eneeno.

Jesu, kondisindikila,
Jesu, kondisindikila, Jesu, kondisindikila,
Ndilaboola, boola eneeno.

items.title: Nomuleta Mubyaabi (Cila)
verses:
Nomuleta mubyaabi,
Jesu ulamutambula,
Naasesemwa sibyaabi
Jesu ulamupulusya.

Twakutamba umukwesu,
Wapampwilwa buli mwami,
Njila kwesu, muna-Kristo
Jesu mwali, ngamucanka.

Kale twali basikufwa,
Inzyo Kristo watubusya,
Wabaleta mucimpati,
Balu, bana, obapusi.

Myozo, mazwi, omatansyi,
Oonse atembaule Leza,
Watumunikila kwakwe,
Nkutuzanda kuba aze.

Nitusika kubulemu,
Okwipobwe olya-Jesu,
Tulaimba, tulakomba,
Tulasakwa ko sikwense.

choruses.text:
Aleluya, aleluya,
Aleluya ku-Muvuni!

items.title: Sena Ulimwizi Jesu?
verses:
Sena ulimwizi Jesu,
Mwami wako Mufutuli,
Siluyando, Silizyalo,
Ulimwizi Jesu na?

Wakali mujulu lyakwe,
Wal’ a-Wisi Namakungwe,
Walemekwa ciindi coonse
Embungano zyakujulu.

Kwalo nawabona bantu
’Bapiluka kulinguwe,
Wabayanda cinicini
Aluyando ulupati.

Nkaambo kaluyando lwakwe
Wakaboola ansi ano,
Wakasika kupilusya
Bantu boonse basweekede.

Toteeleli nakwiita
Ati, “Boola kulindime,
Ufutulwe kukubisya
Ube mucilili wangu”?

“Ii, Jesu ndazumina,
Ndilaboola eno, Mwami,
Undiponye, undibambe,
Ndicilile nduwe lyoonse.”

choruses.text:
Yanda Jesu Mufutuli,
Nguwe uwakakufwida,
Wamuyanda ulajanwa,
Ufutulwe sunu buya.

items.title: Ulainda Akufwamba
verses:
Ulainda akufwamba;
Ino nkuli nkotiye?
Uliizi inzila eyi
Njoceenda anjiyo?
||Ulainda, ulainda,
Uya ’ko kujulu na?||

Ulainda akufwamba;
Taliim’ izuba, pe,
Lyapasula, lilabbila,
Yebo, tokoobbila na?
||Ulainda, ulainda,
Tokookala ano, pe.||

Ulainda akufwamba,
Uindila kul’ ino?
’Ko kujulu tokoonjila,
Ootanasanduka, pe.
||Ulainda, ulainda,
Ulaboola lil’ ino?||

Ulainda akufwamba;
Kul’ afwaafwi kufwa. Ma!
Kwina ukutakwe cuumbwe,
Uyoovunwa yebo na?
||Ulainda, ulainda,
Takusail kufwa, pe.||

Ulainda akufwamba;
Wajatilwa zibi na?
Sunu mbobuzuba bwako,
Tokoojana ciindi kuya.
||Ulainda, ulainda,
Tokoojana ciindi kuya.||

items.title: Noonse Muzize Muteelele (Cila)
verses:
Noonse muzize muteelele
Mbwaatufwila Jesu,
Ngu-Mwami wesu Mufutuli,
Mwami Usimanga.

’Tuleke sibyaabi syoonse,
Jesu watuzanda,
’Tucite siluleme syoonse,
Jesu abotelwe.

Inzyo aswe natukasambe
Mumalow’ aa-Mwami,
Atusalale cinicini,
Tumusyome Jesu.

choruses.text:
Natumukombe, tumulumbe,
Nguwe siluse uululeme,
Wakafwila bantu boonse
Ati bafutuke.

items.title: Mweembezi Nguwakandijana
verses:
Mweembezi nguwakandijana, nkendi mubi, Wakan-
diendela munyika, kundivuna.

Mweembezi mubotu ngu-Jesu, ngu-Muvuni,
Mwana Wambele Mubotu, ngu-Jesu.

Mulufu lwa-Mwami ndajana lufutuko,
Nkaambo kabulowa bwa-Jesu bwaka-tika.

choruses.text:
Ndilaboola ku-Mwana Leza, kundivuna,
Ulakomzya kundisalazya, Mwami Jesu.

items.title: Mwaambile Jesu
verses:
Wakatazigwa mumoyo sena?
Mwaambile Jesu, mwaambile Jesu;
Wakatazigwa mumoyo sena?
Mwaambile Jesu alike.

Ulalila misozi nopenga,
Mwaambile Jesu, mwaambile Jesu;
Usisilaanzi cibi mumoyo,
Mwaambile Jesu alike.

Ulayoowa kupenga mumoyo,
Mwaambile Jesu, mwaambile Jesu;
Uyanda kuziba iziboola,
Mwaambile Jesu alike.

Ulapenzegwa noyeeya lufu,
Mwaambile Jesu, mwaambile Jesu;
Ulalila bulelo buboola,
Mwaambile Jesu alike.

choruses.text:
Mwaambile Jesu, mwaambile Jesu,
Mweenzuma ngotwaziba;
Takwe mweenzinyolo mbuli Jesu,
Mwaambile Jesu alike.

items.title: Inguzu Mubulowa
verses:
Sena uyanda kusowa cibi?
Muli-inguzu mubulowa;
Ulayanda kuzunda Saatani
Mul’ enguzu mubulowa.

Sena ulayanda kwaangululwa?
Muli-inguzu mubulowa;
Boola usalazigwe Kalvari,
Mul’ enguzu mubulowa.

Uyanda kutuba mbuli caanda?
Muli-inguzu mubulowa;
Sa ulabotelwa kumwiimbila?
Mul’ enguzu mubulowa.

choruses.text:
Inguzu ziyoosya milimo,
Bulowa bwa-Jesu;
Inguzu zyakweenda kabotu,
Mubulowa bwakwe Mwami.

items.title: Nda mukombelela
verses:
Ndijisi Mwami uukala mujulu,
Ngonguwe wacita milimo mibotu,
Ulatulindila mujulu usunu,
Ndilamwaambila, “Kamuboola ’nywebo.”

Ndijisi Taata uutupa aswebo
Lusyomo lubotu lutamani lwesu
Watwiita eno kuyooswana kwakwe,
Ndayanda anywebo kwiinka amebo.

Na mulijisi cibanda ca-Leza,
Kamukambauka makani aa-Jesu
Atukombe Mwami abaite bamwi,
Kobayovwa bamwi kuziba inzila.

choruses.text:
Ndamukombelela, ndamukombelela,
Ndamukombelela, ukuti mupone.

items.title: Jesu Wamwiita
verses:
Jesu wamwiita sunu kumuunzi,
Kwiita sunu, kwiita sunu;
Nkaambonzi ulamutanda Mwami?
Kule, kule okuya.

Jesu waita kulyookezya,
Kwiita sunu, kwiita sunu;
Koleta mukuli kulinguwe,
Boola, takakutandi.

Ulakombelela Mwami eno,
Kotelela, kotelela;
Abo basyoma balatangala,
Fwambaana eneeno.

choruses.text:
Kwiita sunu, Kwiita sunu,
Jesu waita,
Waita boonse sunu.

items.title: Ndilaboola, Jesu Mwami
items.original: I AM COMING TO THE CROSS
verses:
Ndilaboola, Jesu Mwami,
Ndiupusi, ndimutete
Zintu zyansi taziyovwi,
Ndilayanda lufutuko.

Ciindi moyo wafwa nzala,
Ciindi cibi candijata
Jesu ulaamba eno,
“Njookusanzya ’zibi zyako.”

Ndalipeda kulinduwe,
Azyo zyoonse nzendijisi
Moyo amubili woonse,
Ube wako kuzwa sunu!

choruses.text:
Ndakusyoma, Mwami Jesu,
Owakafwa nkaambo kangu
Ndalibonzya kulinduwe,
Ndifutula, Mwami, eno.

items.title: Utamutandi
verses:
Utamutandi Mufutuli,
Tambula luzyalo eno;
Ciyakusika,
Ciindi cakumana,
Utatandi Mufutuli.

Utamutandi Mufutuli,
Yeeya ciindi calubeta;
Mapenzi alo
Nawamuka oko,
Utatandi Mufutuli.

choruses.text:
Utamutandi, utamutandi,
Nacikwiita aluzyalo
Owakamusiya;
Ukuti akakutambule
Buzuba butamani,
Utamutandi kumoyo wako,
Utamutandi.

items.title: Swebo ’Tunyamuke Toonse
verses:
Swebo ’tuntamuke toonse,
Mukubisya kwesu,
Katuya amoyo woonse
Kuli-Leza wesu.

Iziyanza zyansi ano
Taziyovwi cintu,
Tulayoowa, tulatija,
Tatusyomi cintu.

Atulange akujulu,
Kuli-Leza wesu,
Nguwe wakacit’ ijulu
Ensi eyi yoonse.

Tuyoolongezegwa swebo
Akusika kwesu,
Toonse tube akulumba
Mumyoyo yesu.

choruses.text:
Wakufwida Jesu
Wandifwida mebo,
Wabafwida bantu boonse
Bezye bafutulwe.

items.title: Umfwile Ntenda, Jesu Mwami (Cila)
verses:
Umfwile ntenda, Jesu Mwami
Njovwa ntakafwililili,
Ndeza kwako nkafutuke,
Ndeza mbwiimbele.

Ndazulwa, ndimucita sibi,
Anukuti wakamfwila,
Ncite mbuuzanda, Mwami,
Ndeza mbwiimbele.

Ome nsikonzya kuliponya,
Ndyaangilwe sibi syangu,
Ndafutulwa luse lwako,
Ndeza mbwiimbele.

Milimo yako Mwami Jesu
Ilondolwe muliome,
Ndalibonzya kuliuwe,
Ndeza mbwiimbele.

choruses.text:
Ntambula mbwiimbele,
Ntambula mbwiimbele,
Ukuti wakamfwila Jesu,
Ndeza mbwiimbele.

items.title: Wasamba Mubulowa?
items.original: ARE YOU WASHED IN THE BLOOD?
verses:
Wakali kuli Jesu kusanzigwa?
Wasamba mubulowa bwakwe?
Sena ulasyoma munguzu zyakwe?
Wasamba mubulowa bwakwe?

Sena ulaenda aMufutuli?
Sena wasamba mubulowa?
Sena wakala muciingano cakwe?
Wasamba mubulowa bwakwe?

Na bwinga aboola kulaba buti?
Muuya kulibambila sena?
Ulalyookezya sena muciingano?
Wasamba mubulowa bwakwe?

Kosowa zikobela zila tombe,
Usambe mubulowa bwakwe;
Mpolili itinti kubabi abo,
Basamba mubulowa bwakwe.

choruses.text:
Wasamba bulowa?
Mbwaakatila Mwana mbelele?
Sena minjila yako yatuba bu?
Wasamba mubulowa bwakwe?

items.title: Sunu Twabungana Ano
verses:
Sunu twabungana ano,
Twasikila ukutwazya
Aba bantu, mbotwayigwa
Mumulazyo wa-Jehova.
Kuleelele bayandane,
Bakayumisigwe Mwami;
Tobasyomi atulumbe
Umulimo oyu woonse.

Bakakale mucibanda,
Bakusyome, bateelele
Mbuli bana ba-Mumuni,
Bayovwegwe nduwe lyoonse.
Kolongezya g’ anda yabo,
Bapinene nduwe balo,
Kobabamba ciindi coonse.

items.title: Ndeezya Syoonse Nsyuufwini (Cila)
verses:
Ndeezya syoonse nsyuufwini,
Asyalo sitonda,
Ndeke nzila iikantola
Kuzibisya buumi.

Njiya, nzuzya olufuno,
Nkakozyane aze,
Ulizi kubaazya boonse,
Aze koli mwana.

Nzuzya obubotu bwako,
Mozo usweyisye,
Buumi bwangu bube lampi
Limunika banji.

Utansiyi, utandubi,
Jesu mulongwaangu,
Ndakubula, ncili mwana,
Okumamanino.

choruses.text:
Jesu mulongwabo bana,
Ube mulongwaangu,
Nkwata kumatansyi aako,
Nkaendesye aze.

items.title: Mwami Jesu Ulayanda
verses:
Mwami Jesu ulayanda
Kuti tube bana bakwe
Wakatupa buumi bwesu,
