Ezyo zinto zyoonse zyesu.

Mwami Jesu watuyanda
Wakaleta lufutuko,
Wazisanzya zibi zyangu,
Ndikanjile kulinguwe.

Mwami Jesu watuyanda
Ul’ aswebo ciindi coonse,
Na twanjila mumapenzi
Ulatupa uluzundo.

choruses.text:
Ulatuyanda,
Ulatuyanda,
Ulatuyanda,
Kwaambwa mu-Baibele.

items.title: Uleziza Jesu Mwami (Cila)
verses:
Uleziza Jesu Mwini
Abunge lubono,
Mbobanakwe bazandisi
Bafwinwi nguwe.

Mubooneki bwezeulu
Boonse balenjila,
Baluleme, obasweya,
Bafwinwi nguwe.

Bana boonse obafwini
Muvuni mukando,
Ndulubono ulwa-Jesu
Ndwabungika ko.

choruses.text:
Kwizeulu bavule
Banakwe basyomi
Lwizulile lubono,
Lwa-Jesu Mwami.

items.title: Maanza Masyoonto
verses:
Ndasamba maanza angu
Kabotu, ndatuba;
Ndaamupa Jesu kuti
Amubelekele.

Ngambile matwi angu
Akutelelesya
Mulimo woonse mubotu
Maanza acite.

Meso angu alange
Milimo mibotu
Akasye ’nzila zibi
Akaambo ka-Jesu.

choruses.text:
Maulu masyoonto,
Amucenjele;
Milimo ya-Jesu
Andiicite.

items.title: Mubumbi Wensi Eyi
items.original: MY FAITH LOOKS UP TO THEE
verses:
Mubumbi wensi eyi,
Muponyi wabamasi,
Usimuzeesu
Kolanga bantu boonse,
Abali koonse koonse,
Abamumasi oonse,
Boonse bakwesu.

Kolanga banjibanji,
Abali mumusinze,
Tabakuzibi
Tabakwe kusalala,
Tabezi majwi aako,
Saatani wabaanga,
Ulabacenga.

Mwami, kobausila
Akooko nkobakede,
’Bamunikile
Uboompolole boonse,
Ukabajatilile,
Ukabaangulule,
Ukabalete.

items.title: Butonga
verses:
Butonga insi yamausyesu,
Akati kamasi nimbotu yalo
Motwakazyalilwa motwakomenena,
Nimbotu yalo.

Bamasi nobayisampaula,
Tobeni besni ilatubotela;
Myuunda minjiminji azyo g’ombe nzinji,
Nimbotu yalo.

Leza twalumba mbotupa baiyi,
Bayiye kabotu makani aa-Leza;
Bapone kabotu insiku zivule,
Baiyi besu.

Leza Namakungwe cilenga wesu,
Kobika matansi kubana bako;
Bapone kabotu insiku zivule,
Banako Leza.

items.title: Leza Pupulala (Cila)
verses:
Leza pupulala
Mbutwoompolola,
Ndiwe ngutukomba,
Usinsana syoonse.

Sintu sibyaabi
Nasimane syoonse,
Pele mbeta syako
Atukasicite.

Ukatupe mvula,
Yezye myuunda yesu,
lyo sizulile,
Tukakute toonse.

Mooneki wesu,
Aze mulongezye,
Umuyovwe, Mwami,
Kweendela cisi.

Bami besu boonse
Bakalikwe ndiwe,
Bana ubakuzye, B
oonse ubazumye.

Izwi lyako, Mwami,
Liteelelwe koonse,
Boonse nabakwate
Ivangeli lyako.

choruses.text:
Mwami, tupe luse lwako,
Ulongezye cisi cesu.

items.title: Kuza Kusiya Kala Ame
verses:
Kuza kusiya kala ame,
Kala amebo kwandoosiya
Nokuba bamwi bakakilwa,
Yebo ooyovwa kal’ amebo.

Ukwesu kulafwamba kwiinda,
Bubotu bwansi buli kuli?
Zyoonse zisandauka buyo,
Ootasanduki kal’ amebo.

Ndiyanda kub’ ayebo lyoonse,
Nawandisiya ndawa buyo
Nguni ukonzya kundiyovwa?
Iciindi coonse kal’ amebo.

items.title: Busiku Bwamana (Cila)
verses:
Busiku bwamana, gumusinze,
Mweezi wabulika Entongweezi.

Silatusendela. Mbalindizi,
Menso aka-Leza Mabonesi.

Jesu ubooneke Bakatele,
Ame menso aangu Asinkile.

Mwami ukumbate Bamininwe,
Basanduk’ abulo Bainzikwe.

Bana boonse koonse Bakubone,
Musiloto syabo Niboona.

Obakanza sibi Nababulwe,
Mbuwabafwilila Bafutulwe.

Basinkombe bako Banzyimine,
Awo ngwingonena, Nintaboni.

Nilipasa zuba Nkatuluke,
Muuza omusweyi Mbukuluke.

Naatembaulwe leza, Mufutuli,
Moza Uusweyisya Uupa buumi.

items.title: Mwami Tulamana
verses:
Mwami, tulamana
Ukuyiigwa kwesu;
Oko nkotwateelela
Kuli buumi bwesu.

Swebo tuli bako,
Tuli imbelele;
Linda mukweembela kwako,
Tutakusweekeli.

Atuteelelesye
Umweembezi wesu,
Mbuli imbelele ’zimvwa
Umweembezi wazyo.

items.title: Lez’ Ab’ Amwe Nimukasakana (Cila)
verses:
Lez’ ab’ amwe nimukasakana,
Amaenzeye nkumuila,
Amavune simabila,
Mani tukabweele kuswaana.

Lez’ ab’ amwe nimukasakana,
Manga amakobelele,
Luse lube nkumubele,
Mani tukabweele kuswaana.

Lez’ ab’ amwe nimukasakana,
Lyoonse Mwami amalele,
Coolwe nukacilolele,
Mani tukabweele kuswaana.

Lez’ ab’ amwe nimukasakana,
Nimukatusakanina,
Atakumaandaanina,
Mani tukabweele kuswaana.

choruses.text:
Ab’ amwe, ab’ amwe,
Mani tukaswaangane,
Ab’ amwe, ab’ amwe,
Leza abe amwe sikwense.

items.title: Tembaula Leza Mwini (Cila)
verses:
Tembaula Leza Mwini,
O-Mwanaakwe Jesu Kristo,
Aze Moza Uusweyisya,
Mooneki wesu. Amen.

items.title: Usyeesu, Utusindikile (Cila)
verses:
Usyeesu, utusindikile,
Tube ocoolwe tubanako,
Tube aswe baswezya-mozo
Tukutobele sikwense.

Usyeesy, kotuyovwa inzyo
Tukwate oonse ngotwapewa,
Tweende lyoonse mbuli bako,
Tukubotwzye sikwense.

items.title: Yama Kumaanza
verses:
Kuswangana munzila ya-Leza,
Yama kumaanza atamani;
Mbondalelekwa, mbondaumuna,
Yama kumaanza atamani.

Nkubotu buti mulweendo olu,
Yama kumaanza atamani,
Yatuba nzila mazuba oonse,
Yama kumaanza atamani.

Njoowenzi sena, ntijenzi sena?
Yama kumaanza atamani,
Ndila kuumuna nkaambo ka-Mwami,
Yama kumaanza atamani.

choruses.text:
Yama, yama, yama kumaanza atamani,
Yama, yama, kumaanza ’tuvunane lyoonse.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Akube Bulema
items.original: GLORY TO GOD IN THE HIGHEST
verses:
Akube bulemu kuli-Leza
Kujulu lyamajulu,
Anansi akube tuumuno
Kubantu mbakondwa.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Wazyalwa Mwami Wa-Israyeli
verses:
Kubuzyalwa bwa-Mwami Jesu,
Kukuli beembezi mumuunda boona,
Kabeembela mbele zyabo,
Kubuzuba bwakutontola.

Amumuni wenyenyeezi eyo,
Kwakeza basongo kuzwa kulale,
Kabayandaula Mwami,
Bacilila nyenyeezi nkoyakaya.

Inyenyeezi yakaswen’ afwaafwi,
Ku-Betelehemu yakalyookezya,
Yakaleka kweenda yakaima,
Mponya abusena Jesu mpakalede.

Bakanjila basongo botatwe,
Bakamuvundamina amazwi abo,
Bakamupa zipego zyabo
Zyangolida, amur’, atunukilizyo.

Mbube toonse tuzuminane,
Atwiimbe kulumba Mwami wejulu,
Wakalenga julu enyika,
Abulowa bwakwe twakafutulwa.

choruses.text:
Aleluya! Aleluya!
Wazyalwa Mwami wa-Israyeli.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Wakasia Bwami Bwako
verses:
Wakasia Bwami bwako, Jesu,
Nokandiboolela ansi,
Kwakabula busena mu-Bet’lehemu
Kuti uzyalilwe mumo;
Koboola mumoyo wangu,
Ukalile mumo.

Baangelo bakaimba akukondwa
Mumunzi wakujulu,
Nowakazyalwa wakalibombya
Mucilido cag’ombe;
Koboola mumoyo wangu,
Ukalile mumo.

Wakatuletela Ijwi lipona,
Kuti bantu baanguluke,
Pele bakakusampaula, Mwami,
Bakutola kuciingano;
Koboola mumoyo wangu,
Ukalile mumo.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Ciindi Bacenjede
verses:
Ciindi bacenjede
Bakakomana loko,
Mobakabona nyenyeezi,
Yakabasololela;
Mbubonya, O Jehova,
Atusololelwe.

Mbobakaink’ akukondwa
Kucimpati cag’ombe,
Nkobakaakukombela
Mwami wajul’ anyika,
Mbubonya kotugwasya
Kukukomba lyoonse.

Mbobakaleta zipego
Kuli-Jesu mucece,
Aswe mbubonya atupe
Myoyo yesu abuumi,
Tukubelekele,
O Kristo, Mwami wesu.

Jesu Kristo, tuenzye
Munzila yako ’mbotu;
Na buumi bwesu bwamana,
Ututole kujulu,
Nkotuyookubonesya
Akukulumbaizya.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Izina Lya-Jesu
verses:
Natukala ansi ano,
Tatukonzya kumvwa,
Izina limbi libotu,
Kwiinda ilya-Jesu.

Mungelo wakasaanguna
Kwaamba kulibanyina,
Ukuti izina lyakwe
Liyootegwa ngu-Jesu.

Naakabikwa aciingano,
Bakalemba izina,
Ukuti boonse babone
Tweelede kumuyanda.

Asunu uli kujulu,
Abavune basyoma;
Uli Mooneki, ngo-Mwami,
Ngo-Mufutuli Jesu.

choruses.text:
Lino tuyanda kwiimba
A-Mwami wesu, Jesu,
Kwiina ibala lyamvwidwe
Mbuli zina lya-Jesu.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Mwana Mucece
verses:
Kuciba cag’ombe
Takuko bulo,
Nkokwazyalwa Jesu
Mwami wanyika;
Kujulu nyenyeezi
Zyamumwekela;
Cilido cag’ombe
Mbobulo bwakwe.

Zyalila ig’ombe,
Wabuka mwana,
Katalili Jesu
Mwana mucece;
Ndakuyanda Jesu,
Kolanga ndime,
Ndilele, O Mwami,
Masiku oonse.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Nyenyeezi Mbotu
verses:
O Nyenyeezi pa kulangila
Kubasyomi, basalala,
Lino tulalangila kujulu
Oko Jesu uli Nyenyeezi
Imunikisya lyoonse;
O Nyenyeezi ’mbotu komwekela.

choruses.text:
Nyenyeezi ’mbotu ya-Bet’lehemu,
Komweka mane buzuba bwaca;
Kotupa mumuni munzila,
Tusike kucisi cesu,
O Nyenyeezi ’mbotu komwekela.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Kubotelwa Kunyika
verses:
Kubotelwa kunyika,
Mufutuli weza;
Bantu boonse mutambule,
Waboola kuzoomuvuna;
Atwiimbe toonse,
Mufutuli wasika,
Mufutuli wasika, Atwiimbe!

Mutazumini zibi
Zilele lyoonse;
Muboole kuli-Jesu,
Zibi zyanu zijatilwe,
Tutangale toonse,
Zibi zyalekelelwe,
Zibi zyesu zyamana, Tutangale!

Wakaboola kutugwasya;
Myoyo ipengede,
Jesu ulaiponya,
Ulaipa luumuno;
Atulumbe toonse,
Musilisi waboola,
Musilisi waboola, Atulumbe!

Ulalela munyika,
Ansi mubwini;
Ulacita kuti
Zisi zyoonse zitangale,
Ulutando lwakwe,
Ndupati kulindiswe,
Luyando ndupati, Tumukombe!

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Baangelo Bakujulu
verses:
Nobaangela bakujulu,
Kamuboola kunyika; Mwakaimba akulengwa,
Mwiimbe a-Mwami Jesu;
Kamuboola, kamukomba,
Komba Mwami uuzyalwa.

Nobeembezi nomulanga
Kubutanga masiku, Leza eno ul’ aswebo
Kamuya muyoomujana;
Kamuboola, kamukomba,
Komba Mwami uuzyalwa.

Nobasongo bazwa kujwe,
Kamusia zyaansi; Yandaula Uuyandika,
Mwabona nyenyeezi;
Kamuboola, kamukomba,
Komba Mwami uuzyalwa.

Nobasyomi balangila,
Mwalinda ciindi coonse; Mwami Jesu ngo-Mesia,
Kamubona wasika;
Kamuboola, kamukomba,
Komba Mwami uuzyalwa.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Tobasongo
verses:
Tobasongo bazwa kujwe,
Tweza kubona muvwanda;
Twakabona inyenyeezi
Okuya kujwe.

Wakazyalwa ku-Betelehemu,
Ndamuletela musini,
Mwami lyoonse utamani
Weza kutulela.

Muunde ndamuletela,
Muunde oyo ununkisya;
Alemekwe, atembaulwe,
Leza Mufutuli!

Ndamuletela mafuta,
Aanunka apa buumi
Kulila, kusinsima, buusu
Bwakujalilwa mucuumbwe.

Mubulemu twamubona,
Mwami Leza cipaizyo,
Aleluya, Aleluya,
Boonse baimba.

choruses.text:
O Inyenyeezi, mweka,
Inyenyeezi, mweka,
Tuzolwede tukabone
Imwana muvwanda.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: O Munzi Wa-Bet’lehemu
verses:
O munzi wa-Bet’lehemu,
Boonse bantu baloona,
Kujulu inyenyeezi
Zilamwekesya;
Ii, mumudima wanu
Knuuli Mumuni,
Wakali kulangilwa
Ciindi ciamfu.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Kwakali Beembezi
verses:
Kule kwakali beembezi
Balindila butanga,
Kwakalibonya kulimbabo
Mungelo wa-Jehova.

Beembezi bayoowa loko,
Pele wakabaambila,
Mutayoowi ndamuletela
Makani abotezya.

Kulindinye mu-Bet’lehemu
Wasyalwa Mufutuli.
Kamuya mukamujane sunu
Babotelwa kapati.

Asunu tukamukombe
Jesu, Mwana wa-Leza.
Twamulumba Leza kujulu,
Watiyanda bobuya.

items.section: Jesu Kristo Mwana aa-Leza: Kuzyalwa Kwakwe
items.title: Mumunzi Wa-Davida
verses:
Ciindi mumunzi wa-Davida
Kwakali ciba cag’ombe,
Oko kuciindi camasiku
Nkwakazyalwa mwanaakwe
Mariya mubotu,
Mwanaakwe wakali Jesu.

Jesu wakali mwana musyoonto,
Pele wakakomena,
Nkaambo wakali mbuli ndiswe
Ulizi mapenzi esu;
Sunu uli kujulu,
Ulatubambila busena.

Cimwi ciindi tuyoomubona
Jesu Kristo, Mwami wesu,
Nkaambo muluyando lwakwe
Walo wakatufutula;
Uzootuzolwedela
Tusike kumunzi wajulu.

items.title: O Mwana Wa-Davida
verses:
O Mwana wa-Davida, ndifwida luzyalo;
Mbwaakaamba oyo moofu, naakati inde Jesu.

Bantu bamutapatila, bati aumune,
Pele wakoompolola, undifwe luzyalo.

Jesu wakaima, wati, “Nzookucitilanzi ’no?”
Moofu wakamuvwila, Mwami, ndika-bone!

Wati Jesu, “Ulusyomo lwakufutula”;
Elyo mwso akajuka, wamucilila Jesu.

Nyoonse nomupenzegwa, ngooyu Mufutuli,
Takooyoomukasya muntu, kuti asyome nguwe.

items.title: Ndabika Zibi Zyangu
items.original: I LAY MY SINS ON JESUS
verses:
Ndabika zibi zyangu muli-Jesu Kristo.
Wakapengela ndime, wandiangulula;
Ndaleta bubi bwangu kuti busanzigwe,
Mubulowa bwa-Jesu, kuti nditube buu.

Ndabika kuyanda kwangu ku-Mwana aa-Leza,
Uponya malwazi aangu, uvuna muuya wangu;
Ndabika kuusa kwangu amapenzi oonse,
Muli-Jesu waayumuna, waatola kule.

Ndayandisya ukuba mbuli Jesu wangu,
Wakali siluzyalo, wakali bombede.
Ndayandisya kukala a-Jesu kujulu,
Kwiimba, kulumbaizya abasalala bakwe.

Ndayandisya, O Mwami, kukubotezya,
Nendacikala ansi omuno munyika;
Ndigwasye kubaleta bamwi kulinduwe,
Ndikumanine milimo, ulemekwe lyoonse.

items.title: Jesu Uinda Zyoonse
items.original: JESUS IS ALL THE WORLD TO ME

items.title: Mebo Ndili Mwana
verses:
Mebo ndili mwana, pele eno ndamvwa,
A-Jehova Leza, mbwaakalnega zyoonse;
Alimwi, baiyi besu balatuambila,
A-Mufutuli wesu, mbwaakafwida toonse.

items.title: Ndilakulumba, Jesu
verses:
Ndilakulumba, Jesu, ukundifwida kwako;
uze undaangulule, ndibe wako, Mwami.

Ndakali mumusinze kakwina bululami;
Wakandimunikila, ndibe wako, Mwami.

Ndabona bubi bwangu, aluyando lwako;
Ndazundwa luse lwako, ndili wako, Mwami.

items.title: Ndaenda A-Mwami
verses:
Ndakazelengana mumuuya mubi,
Lino ndakomana, ndalyookezya;
Mazuba oonse ndilaimba lwiimbo,
Mkaaka kaambo, ndaenda ’Mwami.

Myaka minjiminji ndakaangwa,
Saatani takakonzya kundiyovwa;
Lino mbuli bayuni ba’ muluwo,
Ndakaangululwa, nde ’nda ’Mwami.

Mukuusa akupenga, kolanga,
Langa Mufutuli akupe buumi;
Lufutuko alutangalo lwakwe,
Ulakuletela, komutambula.

choruses.text:
Ndaenda a-Mwami mubotu, ndaenda
A-Mufutuli;
Nsizimini pe, ndaya kumunzi,
Ndaenda a-Mwami wangu.

items.title: Wandimvwenta
verses:
Wandimvwenta, wandimvwenta,
Nindakali kweendenda kulale;
Wandimvwenta, wandijana,
Bwakali buzuba bubotu.

items.title: Leta Mulilo
Majwi Alubomba
verses:
||Majwi alubomba taafwi, taafwi;||
Taafwi, pe.

items.title: Danyeli
verses:
||Danyeli wakoona mucililo cabasyuumbwa,
Wakumbila Leza kumuyovwa;||
Nkabela walila “Yo!”
Nkabela walila “Yo!”
Nkabela walila “Leza Namakungwe!”

items.title: Mwami Akuboola
verses:
||Mwami akuboola omuno munyika,
Kutola bantu bakwe basyomeka.||

||Mulimigwagwa mibotu, itubatuba,
Maanda mabotu anyengema.||

||Mulimasani mabotu, amwekamweka,
Misini mibotu yangolida.||

choruses.text:
Ndinjile sena? Ndinjile sena?
Ndinjile sena, Mwami ndafutulwa?
Ndinjila sena? Ndinjile sena?
Nsinjile sena, Mwami, mu-Zioni?

items.title: Nywebo Nobakaka
verses:
||Nywebo nomukaka, ukusanduka,
Ndinywe bana ba-Saatani.||

||Nywebo nomuti, “Tuli bana-Leza”;
Amutambike matansyi.||

choruses.text:
||Muzoolila, “Mayo! Mayo! Mayo!
Buumi bwangu bwasweeka!”||

items.title: Leza Wakaambila Noa
verses:
Leza wakaambila Noa,
Wakati, “Kobeza bwaato,
Misyobo yoonse utole,
Ukaibike mubwaato.”

Wakatuma cikwangala,
Wati, “Cikalange inyika.”
Takukwe nakabwedela,
Wakagama kuzelengana.

Limwi wakatuma nziba,
Wati, “Ikalange inyika.”
Yez’ atewo lyamukuyu,
Kuzibya kuti nyika yayuma.

Maanzi naakayuminina
Boonse bakazwida anze
Noa wayaka kasanza,
Kakupailila Jehova.

choruses.text:
||Bakacedwa, bakacedwa,
Mane zambangulwe lyasika.||

items.title: Akundiita
Ivangeli
Ndayanda Kuya
items.original: I WANT TO GO TO HEAVEN
verses:
||Ndayanda kuya kujulu,
Kujulu, kujulu, nandafwa;||
||Kujulu, ndafwa, julu, julu, julu,
Kujulu ndafwa, julu, julu, nandafwa.||

items.title: Bantu Boonse Bazyibe
verses:
||Bantu boonse bazyibe,
Bantu boonse bazyibe,
Bantu boonse bazyibe Jesu Mwami.||
Uli mubotu kwiinda boonse,
Uli ’ntanda imweka;
Uli kwiinda bantu boonse,
Bantu boonse bazyibe.

items.title: Muzezi Wabantu
verses:
Ndiyookucita muzezi wabantu,
Muzezi wabantu, muzezi wabantu;
Ndiyookucita muzezi wabantu,
Nawancilila.
Nawancilila, nawancilila,
Ndiyookucita muzezi wabantu,
Nawancilila.

Jesu ulaita, “Koboola ’kuno,
Koboola ’kuno, koobola ’kuno”;
Jesu ulaita, “Koboola ’kuno,
Ukalyookezye.
Ukalyookezye, ukalyookezye”;
Jesu ulaita, “Koboola ’kuno,
Ukalyookezye.”

Komba, bala iBaibele,
IBaibele, iBaibele, Mazuba oonse.
Mazuba oonse, mazuba oonse,
Komba, bala iBaibele,
Mazuba oonse.

items.title: Mwami Undizolwede
items.original: LEAD ME TO SOME SOUL TODAY
verses:
Mwami, undizolwede kubantu kubaambila,
Beenzuma basweekeded nkaambo teebalizi;
Mbace basikubagwasya ta’ali banji bakomba,
Ndipa moyo wabuumi kuzolweda bantu.

items.title: Syoma Nguwe
verses:
Syoma nguwe, aluyando lwakwe,
Syoma nguwe, aluse lwakwe;
Syoma nguwe, Leza wajulu,
Kosyoma Mufutuli.

items.title: Kamuboola
verses:
||Kamuboola nyoonse, tukombe,
Balamukomba Jesu;||
||Balamukomba, balamukomba,
Balamukomba Jesu.||

items.title: Makani Angu
verses:
Makani angu, lwiimbo lwangu,
Nketembaula, Jesu wangu;
Makani angu, lwiimbo lwangu,
Nketembaula, Jesu wangu.

items.title: Jona
verses: ||Ulaamba Jona, ulaamba Jona ku-Niniva.||
||Ulalila Jona, ulalila Jona ku-Niniva.||

items.title: Ndinoolumba Jesu
verses:
Ndinoolumba Jesu, Jesu,
Ndinoolumba Mwami wangu,
Uwandiyanda wandifwida,
Ndinoolumba Jesu.

items.title: Coonse Ciindi
items.original: EVERY TIME I FEEL THE SPIRIT
verses:
||Coonse ciindi ndamvwa
Muuya Usalala mulindime,||
||Mumalundu, mutulundu,
Mutunkolola, mulwizyi.||

items.title: Mwami Wangu
verses:
||Mwami wangu, Mwami wangu,
Ndilongezya o-Mwami;||
||Acikamu cabaangelo, Cindiswenye nkobede.||

items.title: Nikodema
verses:
Kwali muntu wakulale,
’Zina lyakwe Nikodema;
Takalizi cakusyoma,
Na munt’ ulazyalw’ alimwi.

items.title: 1 Johane 1:9
verses:
Na twalyaamba zibi zyesu,
Leza walo ulasyomeka,
Ulatulekelela zibi
Nkaambo ka-Jesu;
Ulatusalazizya zitaluleme zyoonse;
Na twalyaamba zibi zyesu,
Tulajatilwa!

items.title: Ulakonzya Kwiimba
verses:
Ulakonzya kwiimba mumoyo masiku,
Kunzi lyamapenzi oonse ali buti;
Muntu ulaimba na’zuba lyamweka,
Pele ulabula lwiimbo masiku.

Mufutuli uli andime masiku,
Nkaambo wasyomezya, “Ndaba anywe lyoonse.”
Zyoonse zililuzi mubuumi bwangu,
Kwina makani mapenzi asika.

items.title: Ndima Kubuka Abuumi
verses:
Lazaro mulongwakwe Jesu,
Wakalikuciswa loko.
Bakamwiita, pele katanakusika,
Lazaro walo wakafwa.

Maria a-Marta bakalila,
Bakamuzika mucuumbwe,
Naakasika Jesu wati, “Mwanaakwanu
Alakwe ulabuka”.

choruses.text:
Bamuzika kuli? Bamuzika kuli?
Bakamutondezya cuumbwe,
Jesu woompolola, “Lazaro boola!”
Mpoonya Lazaro wakabuka.

items.title: Konjila Mumoyo
verses:
Jesu Mwami, Jesu Mwami, konjila mumoyo
wangu,
Njila sunu, kala lyoonse, konjila mumoyo, Jesu.

items.title: Tuyaka Nganda
verses:
||Tuyaka g’anda, tuyaka g’anda,
Tuyaka g’anda ya-Mwami;||
Nobatata mutugwasye, nobamama mutugwasye,
Kuyaka g’anda ya-Mwami,
Nobalombe mutugwasye, nobasimbi mutugwasye,
Kuyaka g’anda ya-Mwami.

items.title: Bulowa Bwa-Jesu
verses:
Bulowa bwa-Jesu bwakatumwaikila;
Bulagwisya zibi zyoonse zyababisyi.

items.title: Cenjele Omeso Ncobona
verses: Cenjela omatwi mbomvwa.
Cenjela maulu mboenda.
Cenjela mulomo mboamba.

items.title: Ndasala Kumutobela Jesu
items.original: I HAVE DECIDED TO FOLLOW JESUS
verses:
Ndasala kumutobela Jesu; (3 times)
Nsikooyakupiluka, pe.

Nokuba endike, ndiyootobela; (3 times)
Mebo nsikapiluki, pe.

Nyika munsi lyangu, ciingano kumbele; (3 times)
Nsikooyakupiluka, pe.

items.title: Kristo Nkwiingula
verses:
Kristo nkwiingula kumapenzi oonse,
Ulizi kubula kwanyika yoonse;
Nawamusyoma, wamutambula,
Ulakugwasya ciindi coonse.

items.title: Ima Mbuli Danyeli
verses:
Ima mbuli Danyel’ nokub’ olike;
Imina kasimpe lyoonse, yuma-yuma nta!

items.title: Jesu Mufutuli Uugambya
verses:
Jesu Mufutuli uugambya, uyookubweza koonse;
(3 times)
Mane do inkondo ikabe aluzundo,
Mwami uyookubweza.
Omwanakwesu, nyika yakutentwa, uyoobula Jesu
Muvuni wako; Uyookusisa mumpangala yabwe,
Mumpangala yabwe ibambidwe.

items.title: Ulakunka
Bulamana
verses: Bulamana bumpelenge. (4 times)
Siya ansi imikuli (4 times)
Kulainkwa akujulu (4 times)

items.title: Luyando Ndupati
verses:
Uluyando ndupati, ndupati, ndupati (3 times)
Luyando ndupati!
Ulwa-Jesu ndupati, ndupati, ndupati (3 times)
Luyando ndupati!
Ulwabantu ndusyoonto, ndusyoonto, ndusyoonto
(3 times)
Kumamanino lwamana!

items.title: Twenda Awe
verses:
Oyu Jesu twenda awe, tukala awe,
Tulala awe; twabuka.

items.title: Jula Moyo Wako
verses:
Jula moyo wako, Jes’ ulakonkomona; Jula moyo wako
ku-Mwana wambelele, Jula moyo wako yebo mujul-
ile, anjile.

items.title: Jesu Mumuni Wenyika
verses: Jesu mumuni wenyika. (4 times)

items.title: Tuli Mulweendo
verses:
||Tuli mulweendo swebo muno munyika,
Tuya kumunzi wakujulu;||
Tuti Aleluya (3 times), Aleluya, Aleluya!

items.title: Sala Yako
verses:
Sala yako, sala yako; kuli nzila zyobile; Sala yako, sala
yako; kuli nzila zyobile; Imwi ilaya kujulu, imwi ilaya
kulufu; Sala yako, sala yako, kuli nzila zyobile.

items.title: Ndili Mukristo
Danyeli Wakakomba
verses:
Danyeli wakakomba zyotatwe abuzuba,
Pele bakamuwaala mudindi lyabasyumbwa.
Naakali omuya, taakwe nakayoowa,
Leza wakabakasya, tcebakamucisa.

items.title: Moyo Wangu Wakali Kusia
items.original: MY HEART WAS BLACK WITH SIN

items.title: Ulapona
Nkaambo Wandiyanda
verses:
Nkaambo wandiyanda, nkaambo wandiyanda;
Wakafwida aciigano, nkaambo wandiyanda.

items.title: Jesu Ulayanda Bana
items.original: ALL THE CHILDREN OF THE WORLD

items.title: Jesu Ulayanda Bana Mbuli Ndime
items.original: JESUS LOVES A LITTLE CHILD LIKE ME
verses:
Jesu ulayanda bana mbuli ndime,
Jesu ulayanda bana mbuli ndime,
Bana bakala ’mubili wakwe,
Jesu ulayanda bana mbuli ndime.

items.title: Johane 3:16
Leka Kupenga, Kopaila
items.original: WHY WORRY WHEN YOU CAN PRAY

items.title: Ndabotelwa
verses:
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa.
Ndabotelwa (4 times)
Ndabotelwa, ndabotelwa,
Nkaambo Jesu wakandifutula.

items.title: Uleelede Kuyandisya Leza
Ndayanda Kunywa Meenda
verses:
||Ndayanda kunywa imeenda, imeenda,
Imeenda abuumi,||
Meenda nywe, meenda, meenda, meenda,
Meenda ’buumi, meenda, meenda abuumi.

items.title: Eli Bbuku Ndiotu Kubala
verses:
Eli bbuku ndibotu kubala, ndeeli Baibele,
Eli bbuku ndibotu kubala, ndeeli Baibele,
Ulibala mazuba oonse, uyoonjila kujulu,
Ndeeli ’Testementi kubala, ndeeli iBaibele.

items.title: Nzila Yoonse Kuciingano
verses:
Nzila yoonse kuciingano wakandiendela,
Wakandiendelela, wakandiendelela,
Nzila yoonse kuciingano wakandiendelela,
Eno ndafutulwa.

items.title: Kuti Ndayeeya
verses:
||Kuti ndayeeya wakandifwida,
Nsikabweedi munsi alimwi;||
||Pe, pe, pe, pe, pe; nsikabweedi munsi alimwi.||
Kuti ndayeeya mbwaakandipengela.
Kuti ndayeeya mbwaandiyanda.

items.title: Jesu, Jesu, Jesu
verses:
Jesu, Jesu, Jesu; zina libotu,
Lilandibotezya, ndilongezegwa lyalo.

items.title: Saatani Awalo Wakazwa Kujulu
verses:
Saatani wakazwa kujulu, tajisi busena;
Yebo, Mwana Leza, yebo; mebo ndilakuyanda.
Utandisiiyi, ndime ndakuyanda kucilila nduwe
Yebo, Mwana Leza, yebo; mebo ndilakuyanda.

items.title: Kwaamba Kwakwe Peter
verses:
Kwaamba kwakwe Peter; nkwakulailila,
Ncinzi ciyootwaandaanya ’kaka
Mubulaye bwa-Leza.
Sena, sena ninzala? Twama-twamana kupenga
Eco, eco ciyootwaandaanya ’kaka
Mubulaye bwa-Leza.

items.title: Jesu Muna-Nazareta
verses:
Jesu muna-Nazareta, O Mwami,
Ba-Juda bamujaya.

Bamutola kuli-Pilato, okuya,
Ikuti bamujaye.

Nguni wakaaba Jesu? Ngu-Juda,
Ngu-Judase Iskariote.

Petro walo watama, watama,
Muziindi zyotatwe.

items.title: Jalula Mulyango
verses: Ndakasoka ndabisya, Noa kondijalwidwa.
Nsili ndime ndajala; mungelo nguwakajala.
Bamwi bayakulila mungelo naayookusika.

choruses.text:
Akaka, Noa, jalula mulyango,
Noa jalula mulyango,
Jalula mulyango ndinjile.

items.title: Kupaila Kusinta Zintu
verses:
||Kupaila kusinta zintu,||
Kwina makani nocilema, kobweza,
Kuti, wacibika kuli-Jesu ulacibweza;
Kwina cinga cilakaka kubweza,
kobweza, Kupaila kusinta zintu.

items.title: Koya Saatani
verses:
||Mukwesu ucijanayi camba cili buya,||
||Cakujata Saatani kumubika munkwa,||
||Saatani uzwidayi, Saatani ocenjede.||

choruses.text:
O! Koya Saatani, Kozwa munsi lyangu;
Kozwa Saatani, Kozwa munsi lyangu.

items.title: Koamba Jesu Kulindime
verses:
Koamba, Jesu, kulindime.
Konkomona, Jesu, kulindime.
Gwisya ’bbwe, jesu, kulindime.

items.title: Jerusalemu Munzi Mubotu
verses:
Jerusalemu munzi mubotu,
Nkotuyakukala akukomana,
Takukabi limbi mapenzi;
Aleluya, aleluya balaimba baangelo,
Aleluya balaimbila Mwami.

items.title: Bantu Basyoma
verses:
||Bantu basyoma muli-Leza bayoopona,||
Ukutwa kwabo takuli kwamuuya,
Balaya ku-Bwami bwa-kujulu.

items.title: Lumba, Lumba
verses:
Lumba, lumba, lumba, lumba, Jesu wandi-yanda,
Dowa lyakwe ndipati lilenguzu mpati,
Dowa lyakwe ndipati, lifutula bantu.

items.title: Jesu Ulatuyanda Toonse
